chapters.title: Chapter 2130 The Pylon Of Ascension Illuminates! IV
paragraphs: <A True Sanguine Clone has stepped on the Point of Death and Rebirth.>
The Clone currently battling with Tribunal Rulers had such a prompt rise up.
Noah's slumbering eyes were extremely cold and calculating as when seeing this prompt again, he actually did not begin planning to prevent it in the same manner as he had all the others!
Yes.
He had seen with Providence.
The most opportune path in the very near future to come...was the death of one of his True Sanguine Clones.
He could prevent it by retreating in the seconds to come and disappearing before any new players entered the fold, but this would not lead to the most opportune path!
Sometimes, death was also a path forward as Noah prepared for it.

His work and elevation of power were still far from done as his gaze went to the Quintessential Treasure Cache around him, as well as the ever-increasing All Source Enhancers, NULLINIUM, and other loot from the NULLITY Beasts!

He waited to see what was in store as immense radiance shone, the resplendent light of loot beginning to overpower even the swirling essences of Natural Laws as Treasure Caches began to open one after another.
The Quantum Dimension.
A vast plane of existence that stretched out endlessly, its atmosphere being one where very unique species survived and thrived in!
It had no designated floor or ceiling as vibrant multicolored Seas of Quantum Essence covered vast regions, and naturally formed crystalline multicolored lands formed other regions.
Everything was akin to a stellar void of space surrounded by foreign and intricate structures as there were even areas of warped space and time...and even points of ever-present singularities!
Within the Quantum Dimension, near a vibrant Singularity the size of thousands of Realities.

At a distance above the Singularity- in the region of the Event Horizon, a radiant Empire stood strong for the past Ages as it had never been breached before- an Empire that was the center for many decisions across the 9 Dimensions over the eons.

This Empire was truly enacted atop a Singularity as just the logic of making it possible was warped, the existences within it that could withstand the force of a Singularity being even more unfathomable!

Countless multicolored towers rose with magnificence and grandeur as all their tips were pointed towards a central point within this Empire. It was closer towards this massive Singularity as suspended in a region with swirling waves of Quantum Essence, a construct that looked like massive coiling of energies to form an hourglass structure could be seen.

Its sheer size could not be fully made out as the constant warping of space fooled one's senses, with its size at times seeming as small as a grain of sand in one second, the size of a star in the next second, or the size of a Reality in another second!
Swirling seas of multicolored essence of lesser concentration wrapped around it and gave the image of a massive rising pillar of light- an image of a Pylon that was carved in space.
This...was the Pylon of Ascension.

It was utterly radiant and incandescent as it was anchored in space releasing a terrifying force that anyone below Nature Integration could not truly withstand, and yet there were three beings near this pristine location.
All three were in pristine humanoid forms, with two following behind one stellar existence who was adorned in simple white robes as above his head, a pure white crown rotated above him!

The two behind him looked eerily similar in structure and stature as even their faces were alike, wings of multicolored light erupting behind their backs as above their heads, solidified multicolored crowns with unrecognizable ecritures rotated with grandiosity.
The two of them had been here many times and throughout their lives as everything here was familiar to them.
They were 2 of the Four Mikados that guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
The one ahead of them adorned in white robes that even these Nature Integration existences looked at with respective and somewhat fearful eyes was someone known simply as the Quantum Emperor.
A title a few others had held in the past as all of those that had held it over the Ages were no longer in the Barren Lands anymore.
And this man had attained this title in the Age of Destiny as he now led the strongest Anchor in the Barren Lands!
His figure was pristine and clear as strands of multicolored hair reached his broad shoulders, his skin actually crystalline in texture as it shone with stellar radiance and grandeur.

His eyes were uniquely shining with an austere blue as if one stared at an endless sea, his lips carving upwards at this moment in a calm smile as he gazed at the massive Pylon of Ascension below them that began to illuminate and hum with a magnificent light at this moment!
HOOONG!

At its Illumination, the identical Mikados trembled as they dropped to their knees, but the white-robed Quantum Emperor remained floating upright as the Pylon of Ascension only became brighter while its hourglass visage began to slowly spin!

The swirls of essence formed this Pylon began to light up as they lost their myriad of colors- the grandeur of white beginning to cover everything at this moment, it seemed like a white line had begun to shine across this space and spread out to the very center of the Singularity.

Light and everything else became distorted, but the white light remained shining with stellar glory as it released waves of incandescent brilliance and covered everything...before receding an instant later into the Pylon of Ascension.

But as it receded, a circular mass of light flashed out from the center of the spinning Pylon and smashed onto the nearby space- the fabric of Reality becoming torn in this region as the circular mass of light began to open up soon after!
And as soon as it did, the utterly horrific auras of multiple entities could be felt as along with this...
"Ahhh..."
A stretched-out yawn that contained no Authority and yet it caused the very fabric of Reality to tremble emanated out.
"To think I would really be back here again...hmm, is that Little Constantine?!"
From the fading light, multiple figures were beginning to be revealed as at the very forefront, eyes full of wildness and regality blazed.
A blinding light emanated from the adornments these beings had- armaments that shone with silver gray radiance and seemingly to be made out of bone covering them on all sides!
When gazing at them, one could only feel the feeling of ancientness and archaic grandeur.
A feeling of wildness and freedom not seen in any of the Emperors across the Barren Lands!
It was a feeling of grandiosity that emanated from those outside of it!

chapters.title: Chapter 2131 An Emperor Of Age! I
paragraphs: "To think I would really be back here again...hmm, is that Little CONSTANTINE?!"
The voice was authoritative and filled with grandeur as the circular fading light revealed those within more clearly as the air of ancientness screamed out.
12 distinguished auras blazed silently and with utmost contained power as their silver gray archaic bone Armaments caused the fabric of Reality to splinter and fracture!
Something unique about these figures was that around each of them, an intricate Obsidian crystalline ball floated around their bodies.
These Obsidian crystalline structures seemed capable of devouring all light as wondrously, the pressure they gave off was akin to terrifyingly stable singularities!

The words were spoken by a being at the very forefront that even the Quantum Emperor referred to as 'Little CONSTANTINE' showed surprise at her appearance, with his eyes regaining their regality soon after as he still did not bow even with the terrifying pressure these beings released.

Before he could even reply though, the light from the Pylon of Ascension entirely faded from the 12 figures as soon after, the space around them trembled. Massive waves of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws seethed as from the fabric of Reality, tendrils that looked like chains erupted out to wrap around these beings as if they had broken some inviolable laws!

The pace and speed they came down was utterly ferocious and yet...these beings merely gazed up and scoffed while doing nothing, a transparent barrier of light coming to life around them as gloriously, the tendrils and chains of Fundamental Natural Laws and Natural Laws were pulled towards the Obsidian crystalline balls rotating around their bodies- uniquely passing through these constructs before they came to descend on their bodies!
"This...I truly did not miss."

The vocal existence at the very forefront spoke out once more while her tanned hands twirled with the Essences of Manadynamics, Providence, Relativity, Entropy...she twirled with the Essence of Natural Laws as they wrapped around her and all those that had just descended as if they were binding them!
At this scene, CONSTANTINE's blue eyes shone with brilliance as he spoke out in a calm tone that was befitting of an Emperor.
<I did not expect you to be among the first to descend, True Empress Katya. It seems you all are truly serious about this undertaking.>
pǎпdǎ Йᴏνê1,сòМ True Empress.
A distinction worthy of a pause and honor!
It did not indicate someone that was the Emperor of a Dimension like CONSTANTINE...but a female that had truly and attained something only a single being in age could attain!
A True Emperor had shockingly descended!

"Haha, well...it is a rather small matter that can turn into a serious matter depending on how things go. My Legion is among the few that could leave their post momentarily, with others to follow if need be."
A dazzling smile erupted from her face as she floated forward.

Radiant dark hair draped past her shoulders and into the archaic gaps of her silver gray bone Armament, her tanned face that of unrealistic beauty as her blessed proportions were hidden with the radiant bone Armament!
"But for you to talk to me like this when I could remember you as just a little sprout from the Royal Quantum Singularity Lineage...how times have changed."
Yes.
Even the Mikado at the Nature Integration Realm kneeled down towards these beings as CONSTANTINE...
He did not kneel.
After all, why would one True Emperor kneel to another?
As an unwritten Reality, it was already set in stone for him to be the True Emperor of this Age of Quintessence!

True Empress Katya smiled brilliantly as her figure gave off a unique authority that caused one's heart to ×waver- an authority that stood above many concepts as this was something that only True Emperors could attain.
Hers was veiled within her body as it pulsed with a verdant grandeur- it was the authority that defined the very Age that she had reigned over.
The True Authority of Karma!

From the Age of Karma, this existence had reigned Supreme before ascending as there was a reason for her to be the one leading the first set of forces here to ensure that the goals of the Ancestors were achieved.
<It is great to welcome you back to your first Home, True Empress. It seems I need to be filled in on the gravity of the situation if you are the first to come here.>

The current Quantum Emperor, CONSTANTINE, spoke out with regality as True Empress Katya appeared before him, the sheer might she released being extremely oppressive and breathtaking as the realm of power she was in was not in the stage of Nature Integration!
It was far different from these as existences like her that had exceeded the Barren Lands...their focus was not at all integrating with Nature.
After all, the Ancestors had sealed Nature eons ago, and they now wanted to let the natural process of destruction follow its course and end the very place that birthed them.

"Mmm...they really chose you to bear the next Throne of Authority. Authority of Quintessence, is it? It seems to be a fairly powerful one amongst True Authorities as I can see why all of this would be occurring now. What information have you all attained on what is undoing what was done long ago? Would it have anything to do with the waves of battle all the way over there?"
HUUM!

Her eyes were piercing as they shockingly unveiled anything standing in her way to be in tune with faint fluctuations of battle that nobody else here could feel due to the distance- her eyes landing on the rupturing Quantum Rings as well as the allure NULLITY from afar!
Here, she could feel many connections of Karma as this was the reason she was sent ahead of all others descending in the Barren Lands.
As the holder of the True Authority of Karma from this Age, very few others excelled when it came to tracking and seeking information!
She had just arrived within seconds as she knew which direction she had to go.
It was the dazzling grandiosity of a True Emperor, and even while facing the suppression of Natural Laws...she had yet to even show a fraction of her power!

chapters.title: Chapter 2132 An Emperor Of An Age! II
paragraphs: The two identical Mikados could barely lift their heads at the pressure that the 12 beings before them released as the most prominent one gazed at the Obsidian crystalline structure floating around her at this juncture, seemingly communicating with it while the Quantum Emperor replied.

<Yes. Under the guise of the Dimensional Conclave, CHARLEMAGNE found clues making Reality itself the Dimensional Inimicus- though it seems Reality is closely utilizing Enders of Nature and even Rulers of Anchors to achieve its aims.>

"I see. I was sent here first because even though this issue has not become pervasive currently with a minority of Anchors removed, this will change if the majority of Anchors are not suppressing the Desolate Mausoleum. It's also unbearably difficult for those powerful old fogeys to come down themselves, but my aim here is the swift eradication of whatever is removing the Anchors and achieving the simultaneous destruction of both the Desolate Mausoleum and 9 Anchors. If I fail to do so in the coming days, more will come down thereafter. Either way, the goal remains eradication..."

The figures behind True Empress Katya released a pulse of profound power as the Obsidian crystalline structures floating around them released an oppressive radiance, their cold eyes not releasing any trace of information while adorned in their bone Armaments as they truly seemed to fall under the rule of the True Empress!
The True Empress that was adapting to the feelings of restrictions that had been wrapping around all of them this whole time as CONSTANTINE nodded.
<Yes. Although this time, the enemy is Reality itself, which can make things somewhat complicated.>
Reality.
The very space where they currently stood on was a part of it as Reality already knew of their arrival!
At his words, the True Empress Katya gazed at the fabric of Reality around them with a sneer as if she could feel its gaze, authoritative words emanating out that caused the surroundings to seethe.

"Not to worry. We were True Emperors and Rulers before, but outside of these Barren Lands, we are Conquerors and Defenders. This time, we came to defend the interests of all our people as even Reality itself will not be capable of standing in our way. Let's go!"
WAA!

pàпdá-ňᴏνêι.сóМ Entropy surged in waves before it was erased by the crackling waves of authority these 12 beings possessed, the whole party following the lead of a True Empress even though the level of power of the 11 other existences that gazed at everything with coldness...it wasn't too far off!
Destiny and Providence moved with purpose around Noah as they told him a crucial time was nearing.
And he affirmed multiple times the correct path to take as this time, it truly was different from before!
To allow a Clone to undergo the Point of Death and Rebirth.

What possible reason could there be to allow for the path of death of a True Sanguine Clone? His enemies had an inkling that it was one of his bodies as it wouldn't serve any deceptive purpose...and there were many other reasons alongside it but, Noah still trusted in Providence as he had yet to be led wrong!

Something else that calmed his tyrannical heart in all this was the fact that his clone would not face Death to any beings within these Barren Lands who were bidding for the Seat of the True Emperor- but those from outside of this Reality and Age of Quintessence as he found his Authority as an Emperor of this Age would not decrease!
But...he still would not make it easy for them.
He would still fight with everything he had and see exactly what forces the Ancestors could send down!
And the best way to do this on his side was to begin devouring the Loot he had just obtained from this fantastical battle.

As the three Quintessential Treasure Caches opened, Noah's slumbering eyes gazed at the overall gains from the thousands of NULLITY Beasts he had taken down so far, with their Legions still being abundant even now!
<220,000 Shards of Concept Modifiers have been obtained.>
<220,000 Shards of NULLITY have been obtained.>
<220,000 Ingots of NULLINIUM have been obtained.>
<22,000 All Source Enhancer has been attained.>
Pristine numbers were shown as a requirement was more than exceeded.
A requirement of grasping NULLITY!

Along with this, a large number of All Source Enhancers that granted Noah the resources for nearly 80% of the Seventh Dimensional Layer appeared- with the only thing left being Noah's choice on whether to utilize them all on this aspect...or use them to elevate the Infinite Forge ever higher.

Then, Noah stared at the dazzling metallic blocks of NULLINIUM that would be more than enough for two NULLITY Armaments as his Will also focused on the golden flaming Blacksmith's Forge from afar that showed a massive melting NULLITY greatsword that had its deconstructed materials flowing into RUINATION and the Primordial Disk, these two forged Relics resonating with each other as they bathed in pristine materials and power- their final form seeming to be interconnected and not separate!

Noah was waiting for it eagerly as part of the reason he hadn't begun devouring all the Loot he was getting was due to RUINATION. Its feature of multiplying loot was too crucial as with its recent elevation, even the multiplication of Noah's current high-tier loot should not be an impossibility.
But its elevation was taking its time.
And time was not currently present as Providence told him terrifying existences neared!

From the description of the Shards of NULLITY, 100,000 Shards were required to theoretically understand this construct and have it move through one's Origin without it negating and destroying everything.

Due to the limitations of time where Microseconds and even nanoseconds could mean the difference between life and death, Noah's will commanded the sufficiently required Shards of NULLITY to surge towards him!

Whenever RUINATION finished its elevation, the multiplicative effects would be utilized on what remained and what was to come as for now, Noah's slumbering body began to absorb the docile crystalline Shards of NULLITY.
The concept that stemmed outside of Reality!
The concept that OPPENHEIMER utilized to help him attain the Seat of the True Emperor!

He would still fight with everything he had and see exactly what forces the Ancestors could send down!
And the best way to do this on his side was to begin devouring the Loot he had just obtained from this fantastical battle.

As the three Quintessential Treasure Caches opened, Noah's slumbering eyes gazed at the overall gains from the thousands of NULLITY Beasts he had taken down so far, with their Legions still being abundant even now!
<220,000 Shards of Concept Modifiers have been obtained.>
<220,000 Shards of NULLITY have been obtained.>
<220,000 Ingots of NULLINIUM have been obtained.>
<22,000 All Source Enhancer has been attained.>
Pristine numbers were shown as a requirement was more than exceeded.
A requirement of grasping NULLITY!

Along with this, a large number of All Source Enhancers that granted Noah the resources for nearly 80% of the Seventh Dimensional Layer appeared- with the only thing left being Noah's choice on whether to utilize them all on this aspect...or use them to elevate the Infinite Forge ever higher.

Then, Noah stared at the dazzling metallic blocks of NULLINIUM that would be more than enough for two NULLITY Armaments as his Will also focused on the golden flaming Blacksmith's Forge from afar that showed a massive melting NULLITY greatsword that had its deconstructed materials flowing into RUINATION and the Primordial Disk, these two forged Relics resonating with each other as they bathed in pristine materials and power- their final form seeming to be interconnected and not separate!
Noah was waiting for it eagerly as part of the reason he hadn't begun devouring all the Loot he was getting was due to RUINATION.
Its feature of multiplying loot was too crucial as with its recent elevation, even the multiplication of Noah's current high-tier loot should not be an impossibility.
But its elevation was taking its time.
And time was not currently present as Providence told him terrifying existences neared!

From the description of the Shards of NULLITY, 100,000 Shards were required to theoretically understand this construct and have it move through one's Origin without it negating and destroying everything.

Due to the limitations of time where Microseconds and even nanoseconds could mean the difference between life and death, Noah's will commanded the sufficiently required Shards of NULLITY to surge towards him!

Whenever RUINATION finished its elevation, the multiplicative effects would be utilized on what remained and what was to come as for now, Noah's slumbering body began to absorb the docile crystalline Shards of NULLITY.
The concept that stemmed outside of Reality!
The concept that OPPENHEIMER utilized to help him attain the Seat of the True Emperor!

chapters.title: Chapter 2133 On The Cusp Of Glory! I
paragraphs: Descent.
An action rarely done across the bounds of History, and something that was insurmountably difficult for existences to do!
And yet, it was done at this moment in time.
It was done as the repercussions were grand!

In the Quantum Rings surrounded by oppressive waves of NULLITY, The Empress rose her head towards a certain direction as her expression became stern, her figure currently weaving across space to appear in front of Althea as her fair palm snaked out to clash with a Xyston that wanted to reap her life.
BOOOM!

Her hand shockingly shone with a jade like crystalline luster as it smashed onto the Xyston like an unbreakable weapon, the Primitivus Nullity Originator in her hands exploding out with even more waves of NULLITY as Noah's visage upon the Throne was pushed back!

The Empress could feel his cold gaze even while his throne flew out further back as swathes of Abominations clawed towards it, her voice echoing out as she continued to look towards a certain direction.
<You have sown your own calamity.>
Her gaze was towards a far away area where a flash of white light had illuminated everything.
Her gaze was towards a direction where unimaginable existences were beginning to move!
On the same battlefield, CHARLEMAGNE also changed his gaze while sighing, and Lilith felt a shocking sense of foreboding as she bellowed out behind her.
<Lucius!>

She called towards her brother who had shiftily remained in the back as this being released all his reserved power at once in this juncture, forming a crimson gateway in the far back as their thoughts seemed to be linked.
It was a pathway to escape in case something drastic happened- and things seemed to be going towards this direction!
The Rulers from other Dimensions could also feel the tides of Reality changing in an unknown manner as even they knew something was coming- they just couldn't fully grasp what!
Across the fabric of Reality.

At the boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, the Draconian Qilin Phoenix Ender of Nature also gazed towards a certain direction as its eyes wondrously became bathed with anger, not even turning around as the archaic voice of Reality moved through waves unto Noah who was currently in the process of swallowing tens of thousands of Shards of NULLITY!

<The more time that passes that you do not release your control, the more unpredictable things become. Now, the Sealers from afar have come in as their power is something foreign. Something you cannot stand. Something outsides the bounds of Nature->
"It matters not."
HUUM!
Noah's voice cut off the cold Will of Reality as his body began to be surrounded by an incandescent silver gray light!

"Enemies will come as always, and they shall eventually fall under my feet to be turned into loot sooner or later. Whatever force has descended makes things harder...but not impossible. After all, my interests are not mine alone, are they? Reality itself does not wish to see the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality be destroyed, so it better make sure to mask it so that it can never be found...or be ready to defend it with everything it's got if it is ever found."

The eyes of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix shone with cold brilliance as it saw the tyrannical will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor scheming- and yet it was a scheme that one could only follow as it truly was the case!
Further away across the fabric of Reality.

Hidden within the folds of the Boundary Between Realities, the existence whose figure constantly changed in size opened its eyes once more as this time, there was another emotion apart from ancientness and the hint of vicissitude.
The ancient eyes of this being curved up into a smile of enigmatic brutality as a single word left his mouth.
"Finally."
A single word...and yet he still remained in the folds of space!
Ingenuity shone resplendently within his unreadable eyes as his visage hid waves of incredible power...from even the very fabric of Reality around him.
From even Reality itself!
Going even further away from this location- in the Mirror Dimension.
Crystalline pikes and structures stretched out all around as both the clear transparent sky and earth were reflecting on each other, a mystic air flowing silently across the fabric of space.

A scene of carnage and battle could be seen in a domain of shattered mirrors as the body of the Mirror of Death, Calikan, could be seen rising from the gray Ashes of the Essence of Niflheim- Legions of calm and unperturbed Undead surrounding it entirely.

Yet the eyes of the Mirror of Death burned with blue flames currently as they were the eyes of a subjugated existence who had run away from the battle with Lilith in the Niflheim Dimension as ultimately...his demise had occurred in the Mirror Dimension!

When rising, the Will of the existence that dominated the Mirror of Death also felt inexplicable changes he couldn't fully explain as his eyes focused toward a crystalline mountain near this location and voiced out.
<Thanks for the aid, Osmont.>

Atop the mountain, the exceedingly beautiful figures of Katelyn and Noah could be seen as they had long since made their appearance in the upper echelons of power in the Mirror Dimension, with Katelyn not being capable of coming across her mother yet as she had joined the escort to the Dimensional Conclave!

After a less than pleasant introduction from the Mirare Lineage in this time of chaos, the verdict of incursion into the Mirror Dimension lay with the Dimensional Rulers currently fighting for their lives in the Conclave as Noah had taken Katelyn out at this time to stop the retreat of the Mirror of Death.

This massive dragon now lay under the Will of Eckert as Noah directly influenced the increase of power of another ally, his eyes releasing a knowing light as he nodded while also gazing towards a certain direction!
"A mere Dimensional Hellion Ruler will not be enough to fight what has come. We shall all be fighting for our lives and homes to the point of suffocation as the power required..."
Power.
The power required to stand tall above the coming enemies was insurmountable!
So Noah continued with his preparations.

He continued as the river of time continued to churn and in the far reaches of the Quantum Dimension- the heads of many Rulers turned as they now felt the foreign auras of utter oppressive and majesty near this location!

chapters.title: Chapter 2134 On The Cusp Of Glory! II
paragraphs: 2134 On the Cusp of Glory! II
Noah's slumbering will was roused to its greatest possible state as he felt the changes in the Quantum Dimension.

Tendrils of Providence arched over his very skin as in the same mindset of preparations, the radiant treasure Caches fully opened to do their part as his Expansive Space began to light up with glorious lights while prompts cascaded within his mind.
Prompts that told of the results of Absolute Loot Authority that at its core- granted Noah the type of Loot that he needed the most!

Mind you, there were only the Loot from the Quintessential Treasure Caches and not the individual loot that Noah had yet to sort through from the Niflheim, Fantasia, Quantum...from all the Rulers he had burned with Quintessential Singularity Ignition in the Dimensional Conclave.
It was only the Treasure Caches currently!

Yes, the Caches were randomized, but they had given him the Lineage of the Nyavagoth True Emperor, he was shown the Failed Modus Operandi of Reality Integration that set him on the path of binding Reality instead of being bound by it, and even the Reality Altering Construct of the Golden Forge that he altered to make his Infinite Forge!
Constructs and Concepts that he needed the most- and all of this came from a single Cache.

This was back then, which wasn't even all that long ago, but Noah had advanced past this. So now, what would three Treasure Caches bring when they came from even more powerful existences and Noah's own authority had just continued to grow?!
The answer was a simple one.
<498,500 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas have been obtained.>
<The Reality Altering Construct of the Eyes of Clarity of the First True Emperor has been obtained.>
<500,000 Ingots of MANANIUM have been obtained.>
<5 Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystals have been obtained.>
<100,000 NULLITY Pearls have been obtained.>
<100,000 All Source Enhancer has been obtained.>
The opening of all three Treasure Caches that stemmed from a Tribunal Ruler and two Mikados finished.
It was a shorter list of loot than even the opening of a single Quintessential Treasure Cache from the Heliotrope Lion Emperor!
So much shorter, but the sheer quantity and quality of Loot involved...it was utterly ridiculous!
Annihilating over 20,000 NULLITY Beasts had granted Noah a similar number of All Source Enhancers. Yet from the collective opening of three Treasure Caches, he had attained 100,000 of such loot.
Layer and even start on the Eighth.
5 Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystals!
A ridiculous number of Ingots of MANANIUM as well as something from The First Age- from the first existence to attain the Throne of the True Emperor!
Enough Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas for Noah to complete the Seventh Dimensional Layer and even start on the Eighth.
And a new loot termed NULLITY Pearls!
It was...truly what he needed.
No superfluous loot he may or may not use.
No unknown loot that would have one seek how to utilize it.
Just a simple and straightforward overabundance of everything he needed!
A burst of loot that could possibly change the result of the paths to play out in the future as in his slumber, Noah did not delay as his Will boomed out.
<Complete Entropy, Relativity, Gravity, Polarity...begin the Integration of each of them so long as your Source can handle it.>
BOOOM!
Glorious and immaculately pristine waves of colors erupted as his stellar visage somehow became even more radiant.
And he was not done!
<The Seventh Dimensional Layer...let it be Quantum.>
SHIING!
His Origin shone with splendor as after lying dormant within the last day, it began advancing forward yet again as a crucial milestone was crossed!

He chose it to be Quantum as from the unsorted individual loot of dead Dimensional Rulers, Quantum and Fantasia were among them as he had attained pristine Bloodlines from them and could generate their essences- so he could have chosen either one!

But extremely crucial events were currently happening in the Quantum Dimension. He didn't somehow sequence his Layers to build Quantum as the last and final one due to its position and power among the 9 Dimensions- his tyrannical gaze wishing to disrupt everything about it as much as he could at this juncture.

And something crucial to note in all this was that before Noah even began utilizing the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to fully swallow the Sources of Dimensions and remove their functions as Anchors, he could affect them somewhat through his Origin alone that held Dimensional Layers!

Now that he was on his Seventh with all the resources needed to complete it as only 2 more layers were left...what change could he manifest on the Anchors when he had all 9 Layers built with Stanchions and Reality Passaged stably coursing through them?
It was a fantastical thought for the future as to see whether it would come to pass, he would have to overcome extreme enemies.
Enemies that were now arriving at the position of his True Sanguine Clone in the Quantum Dimension as Providence began to veer in an unknown direction!
In the vibrantly multicolored region filled with Seas of Quantum Essence.
Everything was still under the shocking effects of the Primitivus Nullity Originator as the Quantum Rings in the surroundings were torn and decayed of Vitality.

Yet at this moment, the raging battle seemingly entered a lull with the eyes of all powerful beings on high alert while they gazed towards a certain direction where the outlines of suffocating auras gradually became clear!

A white robe adorned the Quantum Emperor that all of them knew as CONSTANTINE- this being leading the way forward as beside him, an existence whose very appearance caused the fabric of Reality to vibrate took all of their eyes and attention.
It was because this existence seemed to have an inexplicable authority and presence that stood above all others- something they just couldn't quite put their finger on!
She and 11 others behind were adorned in fantastical silver gray bone Armaments, with dazzling Obsidian crystalline circular structures rotating around each of them uniquely.
This existence besides CONSTANTINE with her unreasonable sense of beauty and awe was the first to speak as an unknown force stepped into the broken Quantum Rings filled with dense waves of NULLITY.
"Ah, now this is familiar..."
HOONG!
True Empress Katya spoke as the essence of NULLITY surged around her, her blessed chest expanding as she took a deep breath in to breathe billowing waves of NULLITY with a content expression!
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: On the Cusp of Glory! III & IV

chapters.title: Chapter 2135 On The Cusp Of Glory! III
paragraphs: "Ah, now this is familiar..."
While breathing in billowing waves of NULLITY with a calm expression, True Empress Katya spoke out freely as she continued!
"It's familiar and somewhat weak in concentration, but it shouldn't be here..."

And her words ended in a piercing tone as her gaze twinkled with a verdant authority, her eyes instantly honing in on The Empress who had rebuffed Noah at this time and had all the remaining Tribunal Rulers around her, NULLITY Beast Legions forming rows and rows around them as at this juncture- The Empress stopped gazing towards the direction of the new entrants and actually closed her eyes while focusing on the Primitivus Nullity Originator in her hands!
True Empress Katya adopted a cold gaze at this as she continued.
"For you to have an EPOCH Relic here and mass produced replicas of Chaoticus Beasts...you are the vestige left behind by that man?"
WAA!

A shockingly oppressive force came along with her words as the Empress did not reply nor focus on her, Tribunal Rulers appearing behind her as their bodies lit up with essence that surged into her- the light of power around them growing into an immense stage!
Against this, True Empress Katya and the cold gazed Quantum Emperor just arriving would have given The Empress their attention, but they found their eyes being drawn away.
And it was something natural that truly couldn't be helped as on this battlefield, there were some particularly astonishing things that instantly drew one's attention.
The Primitivus Nullity Originator is one thing, but there was another that was utterly breathtaking as one couldn't easily miss it!
It was the Emperor sitting on a floating throne while adorned with a floating solidified crown that vibrated with the ecritures of QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.
The eyes of all new arrivals were drawn here as Princess Katya looked at this with squinted eyes, turning towards the figure of CONSTANTINE beside her in a questioning gaze.

"I thought they had designated you to be the True Emperor after that whole debacle with OPPENHEIMER, so what is this? How did you all allow someone else to already attain a distinction of rulership of this Age?"
WAA!

A shocking question arose as the Quantum Emperor gazed with utmost coldness towards Noah! He didn't reply to True Empress Katya as he instead addressed the existence wielding a Dimensional Reality Xyston while staring at them with utmost scrutiny.
<Are you the Emperor who recently tried to forge a Construct rivaling mine in this Age and failed? How bold of you to have attained the distinction of Quintessential when your actions are not!>
His voice was booming as the Aura Potency hidden within it far exceeded even CHARLEMAGNE and Lilith.

His white robes seemed unblemished and full of grandeur as his blue eyes were as vast as the Endless Seas of Fantasia, his distinction special and above others innately as the only being he lost out to in terms of oppressiveness were the 12 beastial existences behind him!
This was the being who believed this Age was his.
After all, he had achieved feats of Quintessence in this Age.
He has built many things to great fruition as he was the Quantum Emperor- Constantine!
Being addressed by these terrifying beings in this gray space of NULLITY, Noah laid the Xyston in his hands on the armrests of his throne as he leaned back and spoke with majesty.
"Sealers and Apostates..."
HUUM!
His voice carried weight and grandiosity that spread far and wide, many eyes focusing on him!
"...this is what Reality calls you all. But I believe the term cowards is more befitting."
His eyes carried immense coldness and confidence as they focused on True Empress Katya and continued!

"You think you can come here and admonish me for seeking the True Throne? Speak of this authority as if it can be designated and given away freely? How did they allow someone else to already attain a distinction of rulership of this Age you ask...do you truly think I needed permission from others to reign in this Age of Quintessence?!"
WAA!
Regality.
Glory!
Fantastical waves of elegance radiated from him as he stared coldly at beings of utmost power that far exceeded many here!
Beings that were fearless as True Empress Katya had the verdant light of the True Authority of Karma blaze in her stern eyes as a trace of ridicule rose as her sonorous voice boomed out.

"Yes...you actually do need to be designated and allowed to attain the Seat of the True Emperor. I would know this best as I stood at the top of an Age once to attain such a distinction! You have done exceptionally to parade yourself as a genuine candidate so far, but this is exactly as far as you go. Much greater things are at stake this time around as the authority of this Age will not be given out freely."
BOOM!
The atmosphere entirely changed the moment Katya affirmed everyone's fears.

The truly old existences that had lived through many Ages remembered her as Albus sighed while Lilith looked distorted and livid, all other Rulers present becoming despondent as truly, a True Emperor had descended to carry the Will of the Ancestors!
Her words denied any other possible opinions as in terms of authority of a True Emperor, who could speak about it with greater confidence than the one who had already attained such distinction?!
It caused all others to be speechless...all others but Noah!
He shook his head as his gaze moved between True Empress Katya and the Quantum Emperor whose cerulean eyes shone with utmost confidence.
"The mere fact that you do not refute her words shows you shall never attain the True Authority of Quintessence."
These utterly callous words were spoken while he gazed at the Quantum Emperor, and he then continued further as he came to refocus on True Empress Katya!
"And if your words hold even a semblance of truth for the Ages that have come to pass, then it means there has not been a genuine True Emperor in all the past Ages."
WAA!
Tyranny and grandeur erupted around his Throne as his gaze was filled with utter majesty at this moment!

"It means that only False Emperors have been proclaimed over the past Ages if they were truly handed this authority...and it means you all can rejoice. You can rejoice as in this great Age of Quintessence, you will finally be able to see a genuine True Emperor. You will finally be able to understand what it truly means to stand atop an Age!"
RUMBLE!

While breathing in billowing waves of NULLITY with a calm expression, True Empress Katya spoke out freely as she continued!
"It's familiar and somewhat weak in concentration, but it shouldn't be here..."

And her words ended in a piercing tone as her gaze twinkled with a verdant authority, her eyes instantly honing in on The Empress who had rebuffed Noah at this time and had all the remaining Tribunal Rulers around her, NULLITY Beast Legions forming rows and rows around them as at this juncture- The Empress stopped gazing towards the direction of the new entrants and actually closed her eyes while focusing on the Primitivus Nullity Originator in her hands!
True Empress Katya adopted a cold gaze at this as she continued.
"For you to have an EPOCH Relic here and mass produced replicas of Chaoticus Beasts...you are the vestige left behind by that man?"
WAA!

A shockingly oppressive force came along with her words as the Empress did not reply nor focus on her, Tribunal Rulers appearing behind her as their bodies lit up with essence that surged into her- the light of power around them growing into an immense stage!
Against this, True Empress Katya and the cold gazed Quantum Emperor just arriving would have given The Empress their attention, but they found their eyes being drawn away.

It was the Emperor sitting on a floating throne while adorned with a floating solidified crown that vibrated with the ecritures of QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.

How did you all allow someone else to already attain a distinction of rulership of this Age?"
WAA!
A shocking question arose as the Quantum Emperor gazed with utmost coldness towards Noah!
He didn't reply to True Empress Katya as he instead addressed the existence wielding a Dimensional Reality Xyston while staring at them with utmost scrutiny.
<Are you the Emperor who recently tried to forge a Construct rivaling mine in this Age and failed?
How bold of you to have attained the distinction of Quintessential when your actions are not!>
His voice was booming as the Aura Potency hidden within it far exceeded even CHARLEMAGNE and Lilith.

His white robes seemed unblemished and full of grandeur as his blue eyes were as vast as the Endless Seas of Fantasia, his distinction special and above others innately as the only being he lost out to in terms of oppressiveness were the 12 beastial existences behind him!
This was the being who believed this Age was his.
After all, he had achieved feats of Quintessence in this Age.
He has built many things to great fruition as he was the Quantum Emperor- Constantine!
Being addressed by these terrifying beings in this gray space of NULLITY, Noah laid the Xyston in his hands on the armrests of his throne as he leaned back and spoke with majesty.
"Sealers and Apostates..."
HUUM!
His voice carried weight and grandiosity that spread far and wide, many eyes focusing on him!
"...this is what Reality calls you all.

WAA!
Regality.
Glory!
Fantastical waves of elegance radiated from him as he stared coldly at beings of utmost power that far exceeded many here!
Beings that were fearless as True Empress Katya had the verdant light of the True Authority of Karma blaze in her stern eyes as a trace of ridicule rose as her sonorous voice boomed out.
"Yes...you actually do need to be designated and allowed to attain the Seat of the True Emperor.
I would know this best as I stood at the top of an Age once to attain such a distinction!
You have done exceptionally to parade yourself as a genuine candidate so far, but this is exactly as far as you go.
Much greater things are at stake this time around as the authority of this Age will not be given out freely."
BOOM!
The atmosphere entirely changed the moment Katya affirmed everyone's fears.

The truly old existences that had lived through many Ages remembered her as Albus sighed while Lilith looked distorted and livid, all other Rulers present becoming despondent as truly, a True Emperor had descended to carry the Will of the Ancestors!

It caused all others to be speechless...all others but Noah!

chapters.title: Chapter 2136 On The Cusp Of Glory! IV
paragraphs: "You can rejoice as in this great Age of Quintessence, you will finally be able to see a genuine True Emperor. You will finally be able to understand what it truly means to stand atop an Age!"
Resonant words!

Words so resonant and profound that they seemingly caused the very fabric of Reality to resonate, Quintessential Authority erupting out and surging around Noah and his Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as his image drew in all eyes.
<<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>>
<<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>>
And his resolve truly resonated with Quintessence as his authority increased purely from this.
Surging waves of authority wrapped around him gloriously as it seemed potent.
As his crown and backbone of a throne shone with blinding radiance!
As it seemed that the backbone of his throne was shockingly and precisely sculpted to the point that this being...
He was on the cusp of attaining something utterly grand!
On the cusp of glory that very few beings had attained across the Ages!
At such a scene, the gazes of the Quantum Emperor and True Empress Katya became cold as the latter rose her hand.
And then...Reality itself shattered!
The Seat of the True Emperor could only be attained if one was allowed to attain it.
This statement that True Empress Katya said held a form of Reality and falsehood at the same time as she knew it very well as a past Emperor!

She was one of the most proficient Seers in the Age of Karma as she was so proficient to the extent that she knew all those she was connected to and all those she would be connected to in the Barren Lands, to the extent that she could even form lines of Karma with those she had no relations to.
In her Age, it wasn't about strength, but simply about who was more proficient in Karma.
And she was not alone in this.
There was another being that had such monstrous skill in Karma that he put countless others in awe.
The Elysium Emperor during the Age of Karma!
He was the closest to winning the race to the authority of the True Emperor of Karma, but at a certain point...he just disappeared.
With no knowledge of the how or why, with the rest of the Quantum Dimensional Rulers left behind shocked and befuddled- this powerful being disappeared!
And as the years went by, Katya found nobody reaching the same stage as her as after attaining sufficient authority, she reached the True Throne of Karma.
The mystery of the Elysium Emperor of that Age was never solved as she only found out the truth when she had ascended.
She came to learn that the cycles of Ages that began so long ago and the True Emperors that rose and fell...only did so after being scrutinized by Ancestors!
If they were among those who would continue to follow their will.
The Elysium Emperor did not match the guidelines that the Ancestors set as this...was part of the reason why the Pylon of Ascension existed in the Quantum Dimension!
The Descent today was not something unheard of.

Silently and without others knowing, things were always kept in check over the Ages as if a leading Emperor was found to potentially not be agreeable to the Wills of the Ancestors, they would disappear!
There were even more terrifying Seers outside of these Barren Lands among the Ancestors that could gaze and find many things.
In some Ages, the Pylon of Ascension would illuminate. In other Ages, it remained dormant as no move had to be made.
This was done because the Barren Lands were crucial to all of them and the status quo had to be maintained.

This led back to secrets connected to exactly how the Ancestors had managed to seal the Desolate Mausoleum and escape the influence of Natural Laws long ago, and the power that a True Emperor achieved...and how they utilized it!
The only Age where someone slipped through the cracks was the Age of Destiny which had just come to pass.

An existence who was not a Chosen Emperor or a Destined Emperor, and yet he had attained the most authority in the Age of Destiny as due to this...the consequences included his shocking actions that ended an Era.
Now...another existence was slipping through the cracks it seemed!
The True Seers hadn't seen him.
This was an impossible task as especially so in the Barren Lands, hiding one's signature was hard- even if one was an Irregularity!
Their life signature would be seen even across the Parallel Paths of the Barren Lands. So how had this one slipped past the cracks?
Katya's eyes blazed with ingenuity as she focused on the existence upon the Throne, her True Authority illuminating many things as she began to give out commands.

"Drakaris, take Aegis and Rose to the Desolate Mausoleum. Scour every Reality and Boundary Between Realities for this essence signature...find this being's Main Body and the signatures of the Dream and Avalon Dimensions...they should be in the same place. At the same time, increase the Desolate Mausoleum's rate of progression towards Cataclysm."
WAA!
A verdant light emanated from her and went in front of three being behind her who nodded silently, taking the light and disappearing soon after!

"You six, delve into the Niflheim, Fantasia, Elysium, Mirror, Apollyon, and Prana Dimensions as you begin to spread NULLITY and increase its pace towards Cataclysm at the same rate. The rest of you...with me. Close off all surrounding regions of space and give us some alone time."
The True Authority of Karma surged around her eyes as she accounted and saw countless verdant strings.
She saw how many things connected to each other as in the corner of her eyes, she also gazed at Lilith and the Enders of Nature.
CONSTANTINE began to emanate a dazzling radiance beside her as his eyes were locked onto a singular being!

True Empress Katya thought of many things as the tool rotating around her pulsed, feeling the tendrils of Natural Laws binding her again and a suppression she did not miss settling around her existence tightly.
She felt all of this as she moved!
She would do what others did when they were sent down.
She would stop a being like this who stood on the cusp of glory...all for the greater good.
For the survival of all beings!

chapters.title: Chapter 2137 I Shall Burn It All For You! I
paragraphs: The buzz and grandeur of Nullity emanated in her ears as she kept her eyes closed.
The Empress, they called her.
The one who stood by the Empyral Deceiver! The right hand of the True Emperor of the Age of Destiny.
These were all her accolades and titles and yet when she faced the grandiosity of another True Emperor, she couldn't help but become somber and enact a plan she did not wish to right away.
This plan was fair and simple-it was a retreat in the face of Absolute power.
And she was not the only person thinking this as on the other side, the figure of Lilith had already retreated towards the Supreme Pontiff as her gaze was entirely ashen and filled with rage.

The reason for her rage was a simple one- it was because people like her and The Empress were realizing that they were completing their methods of escape for no other reason than the fact that the newly entering Quantum Emperor and even the True Empress Katya...did not have their eyes on them.

As Reality shattered around them, these beings with terrifying stature and oppressive levels of power- the beings that were adorned in the Bone Armaments of unknown creatures...they all surrounded a single being and cut off all paths of escape for him as such a thing for Lilith and The Empress meant the complete and utter disregard for their position.
It was a great insult to their power, but at the same time, it greatly aided in what they wish to do here today!
HOONG!

While True Empress Katya descended onto the battlefield fully, Lilith's body became wrapped by the Crimson Gateway that was opened by her brother while The Empress clasped the Primitivus Nullity Originator and became wrapped in a wondrous surge of Nullity that extended onto the remaining Tribunal Rulers.

The legions of Abominations that were placed out began to turn into streaks of light that returned into their bodies, the powerful Epoch Relic in the hands of The Empress letting out an incandescent light as their figures quickly disappeared!
Retreat.
This was the path that all Emperors here saw because the other side...was death!

So those who could leave began leaving as among those staying behind, the visage of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR reigned supreme...his eyes not filled with an ounce of fear as his stellar Spear already roared with radiant blue flames!
Across the folds of Space-Time.
Crimson black waves of Apollyon Essence raged in the folds of space as the bodies of Lilith and a few others traversed great distances to instantly retreat into this Dimension.

The breathing of all the Dimensional Rulers that had joined in this escape was ragged-which was unique to see as it was brought about by no one other than the Aura Potency and feeling of Death from the oppressive power of those who had descended.
The body of Lilith was trembling with rage as her brother floated beside her with a look of contemplation that did not remain for too long as Lilith's angry bellows echoed out.
<Fuck...fuck!>
WAA!
<Disregard. They actually disregarded my entire existence as if in the grand scheme of things...I do not matter!>
Her words held rage, yes, but at the same time, one could feel immense pain and suffocation from them!
Because she had her goals and ideals.
She wanted to attain the seat of the True Emperor in order to rectify what was done in the Last Age.
What they did to her father. She wanted to pay back those that had gone against her and of course, save her home along the way!

But the level of disregard she had faced today caused her to want to destroy everything around her as the billowing waves of magma and flames in the skies of Apollyon that they had appeared in began to rise.
The Supreme Pontiff Lucius was about to console his sister when his gaze and the gazes of all Rulers here instantly changed.
Because from afar, they felt the aura of another existence near them. They knew this aura...as well as the voice that resonated soon after!
"If you thought you were having a bad day, it's about to get even worse for you, my dear Dimensional Queen.>

The last set of words were said in an extremely mocking tone as the grand figure of the True Sanguine Clone of none other than Noah appeared before the retreating figures of Lilith, Lucius, and others.
Yes!
Noah's clone arrived exactly where Lilith and the others had retreated as the stage of the battle in the Dimensional Conclave was reaching unprecedented levels!

The enemies that were coming were two domineering as Noah had to be even more so. So he moved up his Paths of Conquest. Since he had attained sufficient power, he did not go through the path of overcoming Regional powerhouses as his clone came out right to face the Rulers of the Apollyon Dimension themselves!
Just because terrifying beings had appeared in the Quantum Dimension, it did not mean he had to stop his search for Loot and let all enemies go.
This was among the many things Providence was showing him.

As for how he had found them so fast...among the Apollyon, Fantasia, and Niflheim Dimensional Rulers with them, there were two that were still integrated to a source that Noah had bound since Noah did not attack them and force them to desegregate!
At the appearance of his Daemon True Sanguine Clone, the devilish body of Lilith simmered with contained power as her three eyes became tinged with ever greater levels of crimson.
She breathed out billowing flames from her mouth that scorched the near skies as she locked onto Noah while the Rulers around her blazed with power and got ready for a fight.
<Your singular appearance has somehow thrown out millions and billions of years worth of work and ideals...do you know that?>
She spoke as she felt the vestiges of understanding of Providence swirl within her. She had destroyed the Line of Integration for it, yes, but she still had its understanding.
It couldn't allow her to see things as clearly and with great accuracy as before, but it could still tell her that an important point in her life had come.
A point that if she overcame...there was a possibility of an illustrious path in the future. But if not...
<Do you understand how your existence has changed the fates of so many things? How your actions called down the existences that are here today?>
The removal of Anchors.
His distinction as the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR!
When looking at the causes and effects of many things...this existence was at the exact center.
And at her words...he merely nodded with an understanding expression as if he could empathize and truly grasp Lilith's perspective.
<I understand. You hold a lot of hatred and wrath in your heart...so let me help you silence it. Let me put to rest the great Dimensional Hellion Ruler Lilith.>

These words resonated with the blazing skies of Apollyon as they caused Lilith's figure and those around her to become bathed in authority!
Her body was still in a devilish form that had absorbed three Undead Emperors, her hooved hands rising at this moment and burning with flames as she nodded lightly while voicing out.

<You heard the True Empress Katya when she said True Emperors are designated? In the Last Age, there were two beings that had the greatest chance and destiny to become True Emperors. One of those was my Father, and the other...was Feng.>
WAA!

<The Great Commander Feng...who ended up dying earlier than most Emperors in this Age- in the hands of a being who had an abysmal destiny. Some even say that Feng's Destiny was snatched on that day by OPPENHEIMER as he then went on to achieve what he did. But the crucial thing in all this...is that while my father's body disappeared, I was able to attain the body of Feng. I was able to raise it and keep its Aspects intact even though its soul was gone. I had grand plans for this as I believed it possible to even use the Destined Emperor of the past Age to attain rulership in this Age. I...had all these plans. But then you appeared.>
Her crimson eyes turned clear as her rage and anger were entirely snuffed out.
A dangerous amount of clarity descended as in her devilish form, she stared towards Noah and continued.

<You appeared as all those plans I had for Feng and many others...I shall now throw them out the window. The crucial body of a Destined Emperor, I will now burn it and everything else I have just for you. I will burn it all to challenge that distinction you have and see that all I have done is not for naught. I shall put all of the Quintessential Authority that I have collected so far on the line for this...so let me see. Let me see this Quintessence that you have been boasting about since we were in the Quantum Dimension. Let me see why a being like you rose out of nowhere to even attain such a distinction while the rest of us who have been burning blood and soul are disregarded as if we are nothing!>
A brooding symphony played.
It was a unique sight.

It was akin to the setting sun on a bright and radiant day as Lilith's body began to light up with tendrils of extremely crimson flames- flames that wrapped around her and ground her form down as she was becoming something else entirely!
She was staking all of her hard work that was already getting torn down to prove something.

That against this unreasonable being that quite literally rose from nowhere...she could overcome him. That the distinction of QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR could be taken down for her to prove her candidacy to the True Throne!

Lucius seemed shocked and unwilling to see such this unfolding result as his vibrant eyes locked onto the figure that was the cause of all this- the Dimensional Inimicus who was in multiple places at once.

There were no words that could be said to rectify any past actions or change what was about to unfold. The Rulers on their side got ready while tendrils of flames scorched Lilith as Ashes fell, and her figure shrank into a fantastical form of a demoness with curves of excellent proportions!
Apollyon Essence surged as the being that was closest to its Source burned all that she held dear, and this essence burned with this being as the very Dimension seemed to be supporting her.
Fair white jade-like skin wrapped on an Armament of crimson black flames, hair burning red and dripping past her shoulders while her opening eyes...
HOONG!
They seemed to contain the mysteries of the vast Dimensions and Reality as they seemed infinitely dense akin to a Singularity.
Gazing at them just once might be enough to swallow weak Nature Integration Realm existences, desegregate them, and shatter their souls all at once!
Yet against their target...they were only met with utmost majesty.
Noah gazed at the tendrils of demonic flames around a refined figure of Lilith as he thought of many things while shaking his head and voicing out.
<This was never meant to be a contest of strength or authority.>
WAA!
As he spoke, his surroundings fluctuated as two more True Sanguine Clones appeared to his left and right, their lips moving in conjunction with his as they laid down an affirmation!
<This was simply meant to be the end of your reign.>
Three Noah's spoke as soon after, each of them began to blaze with the scorching cerulean light of Quintessential Singularity Ignition.

Along with this, a radiant silver gray light had begun to illuminate in his eyes as this...was the terrifying light of NULLITY that had been fluidly filling up the Origin of his main body- even this concept about to enter the fray as even with Providence, Noah did not know how drastically things would change!

So his three Clones moved out like the points of Singularities that they were, intent on closing off a chapter of a particularly powerful enemy while at the same time...he eyed to devour the Anchor that was the Apollyon Dimension!
When Lilith made her escape, she disappeared into the Apollyon Dimension with her forces...but what about The Empress?
Her return was uniquely not into the Main Reality- although it was still in the Desolate Mausoleum.
WAP!
Arcs of NULLITY and waves of spatial light twisted as an injured Althea, Ezekiel, and the Eminent Mastermind appeared alongside The Empress in a region located within the Boundary Between Realities.

And moments later, she turned her gaze towards a certain direction as with clear eyes, she spoke out into nothingness.
<He said you would be here to lend aid in the case any of them descended.>
She spoke out into nothingness with an astounding resolve, the very fabric of Reality vibrating at her words and focusing as even it didn't know what existence was being addressed by The Empress!

chapters.title: Chapter 2139 A Flash Of NULLITY! I
paragraphs: <He said you would be here to lend aid in the case any of them descended.>
While clasping the Primitivus Nullity Originator, The Empress spoke with confidence into nothingness as what followed her...was only silence!
Even Reality fluctuated and paid attention to this moment in time as The Empress was not rebuffed, continuing to speak with utmost certainty as if what OPPENHEIMER had told her could never be wrong.
<The survival of the Desolate Mausoleum. The promise from the Last Age still remains and waits to be completed now. All conditions have been met as the only thing left is for you to make a move.>
She spoke of daring secrets nobody knew as the folds of space remained empty, and she was about to speak again when...
RIIP!
The void of space cracked and split.

From it, a single eyeball could be seen as the splitting of the folds of Reality was akin to the brows of an eye rising- ots pupil locking onto The Empress as the Tribunal Rulers around her felt their blood run cold and nearly freeze while an archaic voice rang out!
"I have waited for countless years to make a move, and I shall do so when I wish to. Return."
A voice dripping with age.
A voice that felt like primordial eons talking to each other!

Althea felt her already injured body be strained even further just from listening to this voice as after hearing this reply, The Empress gave a light nod and clasped the Primitivus Nullity Originator once more, a unique light beginning to wrap around their figures to take them away from here.
The moment she affirmed what she came to affirm, she moved as there were too many things to account for!
Like the fact that she was returning to the Main Reality that had lost the Empyral Domain of Nature.
Like the fact that among the Rulers returning, they were 1 Tribunal Ruler off!
In the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

Waves of glorious radiance danced all around as below the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, Noah's Dream and Avalon Dimensional Chassis had returned with the Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers, the gazes of these beings ranging widely as they had many things to think about!

But before they could even resolve prior surprises, new ones came as in the halcyon skies of the Dream Dimension, a massive film of light showed the perspective of Noah's True Sanguine Clone in the Quantum Dimension as it showed all things happening here.
Another massive film of light played events in the Apollyon Dimension as Guinevere's will placed half of the attention towards this.
The other half was on the Quantum Dimension as the events playing out had too much at stake!
<We should be out there putting our lives on the line as well.>

The voice of the Dreamer of Providence echoed out as this aged being burned with the light of glory, seeing beings he knew perishing under Noah's hands or the hands of Lilith and CHARLEMAGNE as he wished to also be making a difference!
But at his words, Morgana sneered from the side while shaking her head with seriousness.

<If you want to die, you can go at it alone, old man. Do you think anything is going to survive against the Will of a True Empress? Hell, I truly have no idea what the rest of us are going to do when she reaches this place.>
Despondency.
This was what many beings currently felt as they didn't see a clear path forward!
A path to overcome the unreasonable enemies that had come as at this moment, they realized they had an unreasonable over reliance on the being who had hidden their Dimensions here.
So Guinevere turned towards Noah's clone as she asked with a gaze of radiance.
<What can we do?>
WAA!
How could they help in facing these unreasonable odds?
How could they overcome them and not wait for death?!
At this, Noah's Avalon Dimensional Chassis anchored the Sword of Avalon in space as his Will emanated out.

"If you have connections to the other 7 Dimensions, reach out to them. Let those close to the Sources of those Dimensions know that salvation is here. That while even Ancestors wish to end everything, there is another choice they can make if they wish to save their homes."
Guinevere asked, and she received an answer!
The others also had radiant eyes as Guinevere locked onto the verdant figure of Albus in the Quantum Dimension that gazed at everything with ancientness.
She still had her connections as a leading figure of a Dimension as she could still have an impact!
The tides of destiny wavered as Providence took reigns.
While they began to do this, a few were able to notice something unique within the eyes of the Avalon and Dream Dimensional Chassis.

They noticed a radiant light of gray and silver that they had abhorred and seen in their enemies beginning to shine in his eyes, the Origins also feeling a heavy weight as when they gazed above- they could see an incandescent gray light beginning to fill the horizon!
It was...the Light of NULLITY.
<What...>

Before any questions could be asked about this unfathomable wonder, all Rulers in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality were nearly brought to their knees from a terrifying pressure release far above them in the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature they had yet to even see!
Here, Noah's slumbering Main Body shone with a vibrant radiance.
The color veered from gray to silver in radiance as it brought terror and death before, and yet now it seemed docile!
At this moment, his Origin was bathed with tendrils of this fantastical light of gray as unbelievably...all his Dimensional Layers shone ever brighter under the shade of this light!
The light that brought death and destruction...was actually causing his Origin to erupt with even more life and splendor as anyone would be confused.
But as Noah gained an understanding of what NULLITY truly was...everything was clear.
HUUM!
Radiance overflowed as it wasn't just him that was undergoing this change.

The moment he attained a semblance of understanding in NULLITY and had its essence vibrant in his Origin, the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature trembled as at its very center, the light of NULLITY began to bloom.
In the midst of Natural Laws and Decreta, NULLITY truly bloomed as a fantastical new stage was reached on this day!

chapters.title: Chapter 2140 A Flash Of NULLITY! II
paragraphs: NULLITY erupted at the center of the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature as uniquely, it was docile under the control of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality after its master gained an understanding in it.
It didn't cause decay or death of everything similar to the mixing of the Essence of Laws and Decreta...it simply proliferated in the surroundings simply as no negative reactions bloomed!

Eowyn felt the expanding light of NULLITY with Noah at the center as when it reached her, she instinctively tried to retreat but when the waves washed over her...she didn't feel the coldness and death that she had felt so closely before!
It felt...warm and comfortable as even other essences around her body were revitalized and increased in activity.
Why was this?
It wasn't due to some unfathomable chain reaction or some unknown mysteries of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality...but simply due to this construct itself.
To the idea of NULLITY!
Amidst the surging waves of silver-gray light, Noah's mind was bathed densely with NULLITY as droves of information bloomed in his mind.
Information about NULLITY!

<NULLITY>:: A state of verisimilitude depicting nothingness and beginning. It is capable of reverting constructs and other states of verisimilitudes to nothingness when manipulating it at the lowest level, and it can take constructs and other states of verisimilitudes to their very beginning or initial states at the highest levels. The applications and scope of NULLITY are innumerable as one can only truly grasp all of its variations after achieving the highest possible stage. Understanding this state of existence is extremely hard as it is broken down into Primitivus, Proficere, and Terminus. Elevation into each level of Understanding grants unknown state-altering possibilities that require more data before they can be fully quantified. This state of existence is versatile in nature as it can be infused into various other constructs or used as a pure output to achieve intended results. The current state that the user has achieved is at the initial level of Primitivus, being capable of altering concepts and things towards nothingness at the extreme elementary level. The level of usage has currently been expanded to 100 Units of NULLITY with a rate of Regeneration of 1 Unit per Microsecond. Current understanding at the Primitivus Stage: .1%. Boosts granted: 1,000% Augmentation to All True Parameter Values...
A State of Verisimilitude.
A state of existence!
This was NULLITY!

And from the 100,000 Shards of NULLITY Noah had absorbed, he gained a .1% Understanding at the first stage of Primitivus that gave stupendous Augmentations comparative to Laws and Decreta- and the Augmentations of NULLITY were applicable to All True Parameter Values! This included True Damage Values, True Defense Values, True Vitality Values...and onward!
If the numbers were to be believed, it meant that at 10% Understanding, that was 100,000% Augmentation to All True Parameters! And this...was only at the Primitivus Stage.
There were also the Proficere and Terminus Stages!
Noah's mind buzzed as he felt like he had stepped on a grand achievement.
And at the same time this occurred...
<Your understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Entropy has reached 100%.>
<Your understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Relativity has reached 100%.>
<Your understanding of the Natural Law of Gravitation has reached 100%.>
<Your understanding of the Natural Law of Polarity has reached 100%.>
<Your understanding of the Natural Law of Weak Nuclear Force has reached 100%.>
<Your understanding of the Natural Law of Strong Nuclear Force has reached 100%.>
BOOM!
The Laws finished their elevation right after NULLITY.

The dense concentrations of Natural Law Essence in the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature turned utterly wild as Noah first utilized Pure Quintessential Natural Decretum Seeds before the utilization of the 6 Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystals to achieve complete understanding in 2 Fundamental Natural Laws and 4 Natural Laws!
It erased his reserves of Pure Quintissential Natural Decretum Seeds and left him with only 2 Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystals as there were still resources for him to do more.

The radiance of laws was dazzling around him as keeping to his commands, the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality began with the process of Integrating Entropy right away even as its unique understanding was still settling in Noah's mind.

This was about to occur when Noah's already alert mind felt the dense and unique aura of the Will of Reality yet again as his Will surged out sharply to see if Reality was truly trying something again. But all that came was a voice from the Draconian Qilin Phoenix as it was grave in nature!
<<An existence capable of hiding from even Reality itself has been hidden in the Boundary Between Realities for the past two Ages. Its power is unknown...and not from these lands.>>
WAA!
A voice of somberness.
It caused Noah who simply wanted to enjoy the feeling of power and elevation to nearly groan as his slumbering will probed for more information!
<<It seems opposed to the Sealers that have descended, and shares a connection with the Apostates and the Emperor of the Age of Destiny.>>
Shocking information came out as Noah's mind buzzed with countless possibilities.
An unknown existence that could even hide from Reality itself while hiding in its boundaries for the past two Ages, with its origin not being from these Barren Lands!

Barring the connection this existence somehow shared with Primordials, it was opposed to True Empress Katya and other Ancestral Descendants that just came down as when all the dots connected...a terrifying conclusion arose.
A conclusion that caused Noahs to knit his brows even in his Infinite Dream.
"Fucking hell...why can't things ever be simple?"

Things were never so easy as they had been in motion for many Ages. There were too many beings involved and too many wonders to even imagine as somehow, Noah had to navigate them all and come out on top!

This new issue was brought forward to him as shockingly, even Reality itself felt it pertinent to let him know of information ahead of time out of its own volition. It meant that even Reality was cautious towards this unknown piece that had always been here...but was now appearing.
"They'll just be added to the long, long list of enemies. I'll be clearing some of these enemies first and just proceed forward."
HUUM!

His vibrant tyranny rose gloriously as his will emanated out. He could only move forward steadily while planning ahead. He would scheme and plan as he would quickly raise his level of power to match all enemies, and he would then exceed himself even more until the point that when he faced his enemies- it wouldn't be a life and death battle, but a simple beat down instead!
And with the path he walked on of his Dimensional Realities and even his Gourmandizing Dimensional Realities...all of this was very, very possible!
