chapters.title: Chapter 2151 An Undeniable Death! I
paragraphs: <Absolute Epochal Fulmination>:: An authority within its own boundaries that arose from the ingenuity of the First True Emperor of the Age of Genesis. In exchange for a third of one's Aeonic Soul Value, it allows you to release an Epochal Authority that absolutely delegates its authority in the surrounding Reality. Absolute Epochal Fulmination allows one to release an epochal repulsive force or an attractive force towards the intended targets, with its effects Absolutely applied to all as targets can only possibly resist it by utilizing their own means with Aeonic Soul Value. The cost of this ability will vary in the future depending on the strength of your Soul...
A boon from the Reality Altering Construct of the Eyes of Clarity!
They included the <Absolute Epochal Fulmination>, <Interminable Clarity>, and <Epochal Radiation Emission> among those quantified.
Uniquely, the cost of this ability and the other abilities of the Epochal Tri-Pupiled Eyes of Clarity was not the essence of Reality or Mana- but one's own Soul!
One's soul as its power was quantified by Aeonic Soul Value.
It was a glimpse into the means of those who exceeded the boundary of the Barren Lands.

In the bid to change the fate of a Clone, Noah utilized Absolute Epochal Fulmination as to all those near his position...he applied a shocking repulsive force that actually applied to even the True Empress Katya!
His pupils shone and spun like singularities as they exploded with regality.
An undeniable white light.
Noah could almost see a sense of the Age of Genesis within this pristine white light as when Katya saw this and felt her figure sway back ever so slightly, her eyes shone with utmost brightness.
This was because at the same time, the messages from the Apollyon Dimension stemming from Carciel had reached her as she realized the target truly had reached the heights of irregulars!
It meant to contain such a being, she had to release all her power even while being suppressed by Natural Laws.
Against the raging Epochal Authority that had even pushed back the Quantum Emperor, Katya's figure came to a halt as she began to bubble with tremendous power.
But the being she was about to direct this power towards...
SHIING!
Like a burning star, his figure had already turned into another direction as he shot away from the destroyed Quantum Rings of light!
The True Sanguine Clone flitted across the veils of space as he surged towards the direction of a single thing.
It was the Pylon of Ascension!
His body burned with authority as his Origin exerted its minimal control over this Dimension to do something entirely different from before.
In the past, he was able to lift the Anchor of Dream and loosen the suppression on the Desolate Mausoleum with an Undefined Authority.

This authority was all coalesced at the top of newly forged Dimensional Realities as at this juncture, Noah willed for this authority to be utilized to twist the very fabric of space of the Quantum Dimension, rapidly taking him from one location to another!
This was why True Empress Katya turned cold as she saw Noah's figure disappear towards a direction at speeds impossible for any existences in the Barren Lands.

And an instant after, her True Authority of Karma shone in her eyes as she turned entirely somber with a hint of surprise, being warned of an unbelievable possibility as her eyes reflected the image of the Pylon of Ascension.
This being...actually targeted the Pylon of Ascension!
HUUM!
At this moment, the full power of a True Empress became unleashed as the humanoid form of True Empress Katya changed.

Her visage then released blinding waves of authority as she instantly disappeared, and when she appeared again...she had unbelievably crossed tremendous distances in a blink as she appeared in front of the dazzling Pylon of Ascension.

Her form had changed from human as currently...a massive and magisterial form of an existence stared towards Noah's figure that was just now arriving at the Pylon of Ascension as it was a creature that would take one's breath away!
A species lost on the river of time within the Barren Lands as it was extremely hard for them to reproduce.
With dazzling verdant gold scales and 10 limbs that shone line pillars of Reality, the glorious form of none other than an Imperial Karmic Scarab appeared.
A Scarab!

Pristine in grandeur, it was Princess Katya who had seen the True extent of a threat that Noah posed as when she saw him twist his hands towards the Pylon of Ascension, she couldn't help but give a nod of acknowledgment.
"You're truly a wonderful anomaly to have been born in the Barren Lands, and if things were different...you would have even joined us against the True Enemy."
WAA!
"I'm sure you have your own goals and ideals in all this, but my goals, no, my purpose here that concerns the very survival of all beings...it is much greater than you."
Destiny flourished.
Providence seethed.
Karma overflowed!
A True Empress revealed her true power at this moment as she no longer went for the goal of capture...it was now to kill!
Aeonic Soul Power began to burn and leak out senselessly.

From the antennas of the verdant gold Scarab, a dazzling glow of NULLITY was actually intermixed with a verdant light of the True Authority of Karma as Noah's will trembled when he saw this, thinking of the epiphany of Mana and NULLITY he was still trying to get back to.
But this was all he had.
A time to think.

Thereafter, everything became bathed with destructive and heavy bursts of NULLITY as from Katya's position and in a fan-shaped formation, a blast that wiped out everything in its path emanated outwards.
Noah became covered in its path instantly, along with countless light years all around this area as half of the Empire that was the center of the Quantum Dimension was also in the path of this blast!
And its fan-shaped destruction only continued to extend outwards across the entire Quantum Dimension as an unknown number of Aeon Damage Values eradicated everything!

sentences.text: <Absolute Epochal Fulmination>:: An authority within its own boundaries that arose from the ingenuity of the First True Emperor of the Age of Genesis.
In exchange for a third of one's Aeonic Soul Value, it allows you to release an Epochal Authority that absolutely delegates its authority in the surrounding Reality.

Absolute Epochal Fulmination allows one to release an epochal repulsive force or an attractive force towards the intended targets, with its effects Absolutely applied to all as targets can only possibly resist it by utilizing their own means with Aeonic Soul Value.
The cost of this ability will vary in the future depending on the strength of your Soul...
A boon from the Reality Altering Construct of the Eyes of Clarity!
They included the <Absolute Epochal Fulmination>, <Interminable Clarity>, and <Epochal Radiation Emission> among those quantified.
Uniquely, the cost of this ability and the other abilities of the Epochal Tri-Pupiled Eyes of Clarity was not the essence of Reality or Mana- but one's own Soul!
One's soul as its power was quantified by Aeonic Soul Value.
It was a glimpse into the means of those who exceeded the boundary of the Barren Lands.

In the bid to change the fate of a Clone, Noah utilized Absolute Epochal Fulmination as to all those near his position...he applied a shocking repulsive force that actually applied to even the True Empress Katya!
His pupils shone and spun like singularities as they exploded with regality.
An undeniable white light.
Noah could almost see a sense of the Age of Genesis within this pristine white light as when Katya saw this and felt her figure sway back ever so slightly, her eyes shone with utmost brightness.
This was because at the same time, the messages from the Apollyon Dimension stemming from Carciel had reached her as she realized the target truly had reached the heights of irregulars!
It meant to contain such a being, she had to release all her power even while being suppressed by Natural Laws.
Against the raging Epochal Authority that had even pushed back the Quantum Emperor, Katya's figure came to a halt as she began to bubble with tremendous power.
But the being she was about to direct this power towards...
SHIING!
Like a burning star, his figure had already turned into another direction as he shot away from the destroyed Quantum Rings of light!
The True Sanguine Clone flitted across the veils of space as he surged towards the direction of a single thing.
It was the Pylon of Ascension!
His body burned with authority as his Origin exerted its minimal control over this Dimension to do something entirely different from before.
In the past, he was able to lift the Anchor of Dream and loosen the suppression on the Desolate Mausoleum with an Undefined Authority.

This authority was all coalesced at the top of newly forged Dimensional Realities as at this juncture, Noah willed for this authority to be utilized to twist the very fabric of space of the Quantum Dimension, rapidly taking him from one location to another!
This was why True Empress Katya turned cold as she saw Noah's figure disappear towards a direction at speeds impossible for any existences in the Barren Lands.

And an instant after, her True Authority of Karma shone in her eyes as she turned entirely somber with a hint of surprise, being warned of an unbelievable possibility as her eyes reflected the image of the Pylon of Ascension.
This being...actually targeted the Pylon of Ascension!
HUUM!
At this moment, the full power of a True Empress became unleashed as the humanoid form of True Empress Katya changed.

Her visage then released blinding waves of authority as she instantly disappeared, and when she appeared again...she had unbelievably crossed tremendous distances in a blink as she appeared in front of the dazzling Pylon of Ascension.

Her form had changed from human as currently...a massive and magisterial form of an existence stared towards Noah's figure that was just now arriving at the Pylon of Ascension as it was a creature that would take one's breath away!
A species lost on the river of time within the Barren Lands as it was extremely hard for them to reproduce.
With dazzling verdant gold scales and 10 limbs that shone line pillars of Reality, the glorious form of none other than an Imperial Karmic Scarab appeared.
A Scarab!

Pristine in grandeur, it was Princess Katya who had seen the True extent of a threat that Noah posed as when she saw him twist his hands towards the Pylon of Ascension, she couldn't help but give a nod of acknowledgment.
"You're truly a wonderful anomaly to have been born in the Barren Lands, and if things were different...you would have even joined us against the True Enemy."
WAA!
"I'm sure you have your own goals and ideals in all this, but my goals, no, my purpose here that concerns the very survival of all beings...it is much greater than you."
Destiny flourished.
Providence seethed.
Karma overflowed!
A True Empress revealed her true power at this moment as she no longer went for the goal of capture...it was now to kill!
Aeonic Soul Power began to burn and leak out senselessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2152 An Undeniable Death! II
paragraphs: Bathed in the destructive light of Karma and NULLITY, Noah felt his greatly elevated Innate Dimensional Barrier, Celestial Lich's Armament of Devotion, and the Beacon of Thorny Consecration all burst in an instant.
His thoughts were pristine as the attack had arrived too fast and too powerful to the extent that even Providence had no chance to tell him anything!
It meant that for this moment in time, he could not change fate.
He could not change the path of this True Sanguine Clone.
HOOONG!

Before he could deploy any means against the Pylon of Ascension, a True Empress had crossed vast distances even faster than him and released an attack within a fraction of a nanosecond as the true might of an Ancestral Descendant was displayed.

His true vitality values were instantly drained as well even as bursts of life force and power erupted from him towards the end, but any rapid regeneration was instantly overcome as the flow of space and time began to lull to an extremely slow pace at this juncture.

The True Sanguine Clone's life force was entirely drained as only traces of his source and will remained, Noah calmly accepting this undeniable outcome as he now wanted to see why Providence had shown that a death for this clone would be beneficial. In the frozen moment in time, he saw the massive visage of the Imperial Karmic Scarab move out its Will with precision as what remained of the body of the True Sanguine Clone...became drawn towards her.
More accurately, all that remained of Noah was drawn towards the obsidian crystalline structure that all those that came from the Pylon of Ascension had!
Traces of his source and origin were taken into it as at this moment while the connection was still retained with the main body, a passive ability continued to show its wonders.
It was <Interminable Crality> from Noah's newly elevated eyes that could see through many things.
His sight changed as everything that remained of the True Sanguine Clone was entirely devoured by the crystalline circular structure!
Calmness and coldness.
This was what Katya saw as the expansive beam of NULLITY she released faded.
What was left behind...was utmost destruction as no trace of Reality could be seen.
The very fabric of the Quantum Dimension was erased, half of the Quantum Empire erased along with it as when gazing at this all...Katya didn't feel anything.

All Dimensions and the Desolate Mausoleum had to be accelerated towards Cataclysm anyways, with the existences below Nature Integration having no chance of climbing the Pylon of Ascension to leave these Lands!
Now, the Quantum Dimension became the anchor that had the most destruction as the attack of the True Empress covered not just this region, but a third of the whole Dimension.

Massive rifts of Nullity were the only thing left behind as Entropy surged chaotically and with great fervor, a sense of sadness coming down on Katya as she looked at all this, a sigh escaping her lips.
She wasn't a madman. Of course, she felt great pain at the fact that countless lives would be lost across the Barren Lands when they achieved what they sought to achieve!
She had ruled over an entire Age and saw the myriad of races and species across these lands.
This was also her home.
Yet she knew what she had to do.
But it did not mean she took any pleasure in it.
It was only necessary for the sake of all others. Because as many beings as there were in these Barren Lands...the number was incomparable to those outside of it!
The river of time worked differently as even though billions of years had passed over the many cycles and Ages, many more billions of years had passed outside the Barren Lands.
Survival was grueling and hard, but in the many Sanctuaries they had occupied life flourished at a shocking speed.
The number of beings she had to think about were hundreds of times greater in number than those in the Barren Lands!
"The needs of the many...outweigh the few."

She spoke serenely as she stared at the destruction she had caused, sighing in her heart as she looked at the round tool floating around her that had swallowed the remains of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.

She wanted to learn about him from these remains, but seeing the urgency in the message of Carciel and just how unreasonable the power that this anomaly displayed, she wanted utmost confidence in achieving their aims as she could not be responsible if things went south- not with something this important!
So her will sank into the tool beside her as her Soul illuminated.
Strength achieved over eons rose in waves as it transmitted a fantastical message from the Barren Lands towards a place much, much further.

"Risk assessment has been completed and is deemed Extreme. More Brigades are recommended to descend as soon as possible to cover all of spacetime continuum of the Barren Lands to quickly contain the enemy. Reevaluation of the level of danger is required as there are too many unknowns, with Reality itself exerting a great level of control."
WAA!

A True Empress spoke in such a cold tone as even after seamlessly eradicating Noah's clone, she didn't like how little information she could grasp with Karma as she relayed all of this and put her word and position at risk by stating that the risk was Extreme!

This would mean many more of their forces would have to be pulled out from the battlefront to descend as they would be tainted and weakened by the time they returned, but the consequences of the whole Desolate Mausoleum being unveiled would mean the tainting of all those originating from it as their Sources...all stemmed from this location!
No matter how hard they tried, they could not shatter this link- so they could only suppress it over the eons.
All that they had attained...could not be jeopardized at this moment as it made Katya relay this risk assessment.
She wanted many more bodies covering the Dimensions and Desolate Mausoleum as it seemed the enemy they faced was moving very quickly without giving anyone time.

When Katya came to this thought, her will flowed deeper into her Obsidian crystalline tool to see the remainings of the Quintessential Dimensional Emperor and what they could tell her...when she suddenly saw these remains were still vibrantly active with a consciousness that emanated a profound light of EPOCH!
BOOM!
Her will instantly crushed this light as her expression turned ugly.
An active consciousness had actually remained and gazed at her tool as what exactly did this being learn?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2153 The Spread Of Cataclysm! I
paragraphs: Verdant gold scales of an Imperial Karmic Scarab shone before the grand Pylon of Ascension as the antennas of this being could be seen vibrating with solemnity.
The existence she had killed actually had traces of his will still retaining itself when absorbed by her tool, and she didn't know how many things he had unveiled during that time!
Her expression was one of somberness and contemplation as her verdant gold antennas vibrated at the appearance of more auras in this location.

The Quantum Emperor appeared with a cold gaze as his white robe fluttered in space, CHARLEMAGNE and the remaining Mikado with him as the Emperor of the Quantum Realm was observing the contrast of the multicolored grandeur of half of the Quantum Empire starting at the Pylon of Ascension and the other half where fissures of NULLITY and nothingness permeated!
He gazed at the Lands he ruled that were halt destroyed as thereafter, he only turned towards True Empress Katya and spoke out.
<What now?>
HUUM!
The massive visage of the Imperial Karmic Scarab shone as the humanoid form of Katya returned.

<The remains to locate the displaced Dimension and this QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR. I've sent in a request for more bodies to cover all of spacetime as the most immediate thing right now is to support Carciel in the Apollyon Dimension. But Karma tells me I cannot leave the Pylon of Ascension currently, or we shall lose the most stable gateway to the Barren Lands. I've already informed the others- make way as quickly as you can.>
Waves of Karma surged around Katya as she gazed at the hourglass structure of the Pylon of Ascension and its fantastical force.
Those around her nodded as a spatial light began to cover them, and they disappeared!
Crimson waves of heat and flames scorched the skies as on this day, bundles of massive white flames also appeared.

From the hands of Carciel, Aeonic Soul Power burned as he coldly faced ever increasing droves of Enders of Nature that appeared before the Quintessential Dimensional Emperor, the Singularity behind them expanding and swallowing with even more force as Carciel could already calculate that over half of the Apollyon Dimension was already devoured!
And the pace of devouring was only becoming faster as more and more regions were becoming blank voids of nothingness.

What was occurring now was extremely crucial for all as Reality itself held nothing back, the Draconian Qilin Phoenix backed by dozens of Enders of Nature as the Will of Reality knew...the pull of the Apollyon Dimension would mean even greater power and freedom for it.
So it had to succeed.
No matter what sacrifices had to be made.
SHIING!

The Enders of Nature surged towards the descending white flames as their bodies burned with Natural Laws, their power not being directed to stop the ridiculous flames that held enough Damage Values to wipe out Lifetimes- but instead using the opposition of laws to the concepts within the burning flames to restrict their power and the power that Carciel could display!

So it seemed like waves of multicolored essences of Natural Laws were emanating from the dozens of Enders that had surpassed a hundred at this point, their Sources burning to achieve what they wanted as behind them, Noah's Clones and Lilith did not tarry!

Noah's eyes had a bright expression as if he was lost in thought, his Main Body currently sorting through grand information that was obtained from the death of a True Sanguine Clone as his eyes gradually became more and more luminous.
He then stared at the visage of Carciel and the round tool floating around him as a moment later...a spatial light surged around this being.
And his expression actually eased from the urgency he felt as beside him, three more existences clad in bone armaments appeared.
Their bodies billowed with power as the instant they arrived, Reality began to change as the situation turned extremely perilous!

The eyes filled with the secrecy of nature of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix became grave as the burning bodies of Enders of Polarity at the very forefront began to turn to ash, Enders of Gravitation taking their place as the immediate future looked grim!
Seconds.
This was all they needed before the Apollyon Dimension could be fully devoured with the mutual cooperation of the Source of this Dimension and the Pocket Dimensional Reality.

As the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality continued to elevate the strength of its Source with the constantly assimilated Realities, its features continued to elevate as every passing nanosecond- the pace of absorption became more and more domineering!
But with beings that could attack within nanoseconds, much less microseconds...seconds felt like days.
So the current mindset was grim for many...but not for one being.
Not for Noah!

His clones actually smiled brilliantly as they rose from the ends of the boundary of this Dimension, the eyes of the central clone having their pupils shine with vibrant luminosity as a voice of authority emanated from it!
<Epochal Radiation Emission>
Another ability that rose from the Epochal Tri-Pupiled Eyes of Clarity.
And it was a grand one that caused Noah to smile so brilliantly at this moment!

<Epochal Radiation Emission>:: The Epochal Tri-Pupiled Eyes of Clarity can peer across veils of falseness, but this is not the extent of their power. In exchange for a third of your Aeonic Soul Value, it allows you to release an Epochal Authority that absolutely achieves its effects on the selected targets. This ability allows your eyes to release double the full extent of your strongest achievable Damage Value in the form of multi-target rays of Epochal Radiation. Everything falling under your gaze can be designated as the target, with the ability going even further to allow the achievable Absolute results of Epochal Radiation Emission to be designated to [Damage] or [Displacement]. Under the [Displacement] designation, no damage is dealt towards the chosen targets as instead, they are forcefully displaced from their current location to another location chosen by you. The cost of this ability will vary in the future depending on the strength of your Soul...
Yes.
In exchange for a third of his soul power, Noah could target all those falling under his gaze to release a multitarget attack that was twice the maximum damage he could currently achieve!
But...he didn't care about this Damage currently.
After all, it would not be enough to decimate the enemies before him.
What he wanted...was the feature of Displacement from Epochal Radiation Emission!
What would buy him a precious few seconds in order to fully devour the Apollyon Dimension!

chapters.title: Chapter 2154 The Spread Of Cataclysm! II
paragraphs: The pupils within his eyes shone with epochal brilliance.
A brilliance flashed within them at this moment that was equivalent to the brilliance of a lifetime for others!
Lilith gazed at such brilliance as she was absent minded.

This was the enemy that had torn down all that she held dear. All her goals over the past millions of years and the very empire she had built were seemingly destroyed within a matter of days, where even the very Apollyon Dimension was being unrooted at this very moment!

She had so much hatred towards those who did nothing in the last Age and the Ancestors who chose to abandon everything in this Age that she sought the seat of the True Emperor to gain a power to deny them.
Yet this being before her...why was he emanating such a level of power that could actually stand against the forces of Ancestors even before attaining the True Throne?
Why did he have everything that she wanted?

This was a passing thought in Lilith's mind as she expected everything to now come to an end even with all the power this being displayed, but he smiled in the face of impossible odds even as two more Ancestral Descendants appeared. He smiled as Lilith saw a scene that would be burned into her mind for however long her life remained.

She saw the stellar hair of this being dance wildly as his fair face glistened. His eyes...their pupils began to spin as if they were EPOCH Relics as they released a heart-shaking light that made Lilith's very source tremble, once more feeling that the damage output this being could release had doubled or tripled since just a few seconds ago.
It affirmed the thought she denied of this being somehow elevating in strength rapidly and within the span of seconds and hours ceaselessly!

And at this moment, his spinning eyes released a heavy and oppressive multicolored light that ripped apart reality itself, this ray of light multiplying into multiple rays an instant after as they nearly arrived before Carciel and the newly arriving Ancestral Descendants in the span of a fraction of a nanosecond.
"Hmph."
And their disdain came as they saw it was a mighty and truly commendable attack that had somehow exceeded 1 Aeonic Damage Value.
But this was something they could handle.
BZZZT!

Their bodies shone with brilliance as their bone armaments alone released splendor at this moment, beginning to change as they turned malleable and covered even their faces with a fantastical glow of NULLITY.

The crimson skies of Apollyon cried out as the multicolored rays of light reached their targets an instant later, but something shocking occurred that left Lilith and the Enders of Nature sacrificing themselves baffled.

It even caused the Ancestral Descendants themselves to gaze with perplexity as the damaging rays of light that should have exploded into the bodies of their targets...they instead expanded into a multicolored circular glimmer of light that wrapped around them as an instant later...
WAP!
They disappeared.
They had enacted barriers to defend themselves, but the damage never appeared!

Carciel's gaze had changed in the last moment as he discerned the true purpose of this radiated multicolored light, but it was too late as the region of space he was in and his whole body became carved out and displaced elsewhere!

And it wasn't just the Ancestral Descendants as the multicolored rays of light also went towards the blazing white flames that were descending towards them, the light expanding to cover them as even they were displaced.

The situation changed drastically in a nanosecond as all enemies and even their attacks disappeared, the only thing left behind being the grandiosity of a single being that at this moment...acted like he had done nothing much while turning his attention to the Singularity that was devouring the Apollyon Dimension as from his three bodies, the dense golden Absolute Dream Authority began to torrentially erupt around him.
The authority to make dreams into reality.

It senselessly leaked from him in unbelievable amounts as the pace of the devouring of the Apollyon Dimension more than doubled through whatever effects this being's Will imposed, Lilith looking at all this with a blank gaze as she could still feel the same tyrannical Will still wrapping around her soul.
She had lost to this being.
She had lost as an Emperor before, but now she even lost in her Will as the past Dimensional Hellion Ruler felt inexplicable emotions amidst her rage and hatred this whole time!

She wanted to find a chance where her origin gained even slight freedom to end everything after losing so much, but her burning Hatred now told her...what if she stayed just long enough to see if this being could actually wipe out those that she hated so much. Even though she couldn't achieve it and was unreconciled even now, this unreasonable being might just be able to do it!
SHIING!

The glow of gold overflowed in torrential waves as Absolute Dream Authority went towards making a dream into reality, the Apollyon Dimension being swallowed with its last remaining dredges with the few seconds obtained as it was bound to be fully devoured by the surging singularity in the next 3 seconds.
As for the Ancestral Descendants?
They had been displaced to an unexpected location that would cause problems for many beings!
BOOM!
In the Northern Empyral Domain of Nature.
"Fuck!"

Carciel cursed as he felt the dense concentration of Natural Laws barreling down unto him, the circular tool beside him pulsing with grandiosity as it filtered most of the essence raging around them- the taint of Natural Laws ever so closely wrapping around his Source and restricting the strength he had built up over many years to the designated boundary of these laws!

The other Ancestral Descendants around him were in the same situation as even amidst all this, there were also Carciel's scorching flames that appeared behind them and raged down without an ounce of control
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor had achieved a myriad of results with a single move.
He sent the Ancestral Descendants to the Northern Empyral Domain of Nature where the concentration of Natural Laws was the highest apart from his own Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature!
Their power faced even greater limitations as Primordials now had a new issue to deal with!
At the same time, a precious few seconds were gained as it was enough for...the removal of a third Anchor!

chapters.title: Chapter 2155 The Spread Of Cataclysm! III
paragraphs: Spatial Instability and chaotic waves of the very fabric of Reality were torn.
Yet in the midst of all this, the aura of a being pierced its way through as his white robe fluttered with majesty.
His eyes were as vast as the blue seas as he tore apart the seams of space to tunnel across the spacetime continuum and appear in the Apollyon Dimension.

True Empress Katya had sent out the commands to reinforce the Apollyon Dimension as the Ancestral Descendants had arrived first, with others beginning to arrive now as at this juncture, the Quantum Emperor was the first to arrive!

But when his Will spread out to cover the vast expanse of space around him, he saw blankness and waves of NULLITY as very far from where he was...he glanced at a multicolored Singularity finishing devouring the last vestiges of space.

He saw the figures of Enders of Nature fading away as beside the pulsing Singularity that had devoured nearly all of the Apollyon Dimension...his eyes met with the existence that also turned towards his direction at this moment.
A clash of authority erupted from their gazes alone as CONSTANTINE fully analyzed this being before him after seeing that things were much too late.

A being that was stacking up achievements of Quintessence and even exceeding him in some areas to the extent that even with the help of Ancestors, the Quantum Emperor didn't have a title as distinguished as him. And with the appearance of Katya and other Ancestral Descendants that exceeded all common sense, he didn't even have the spotlight to show his own grandiosity as the genuine Emperor of this Age, this spot light being taken by this being instead.
Lesser beings would feel threatened.
But CONSTANTINE retained his confidence as his figure turned into a streak of pure light to close the distance between them, his grandeur emanating out as his voice blanketed everything.
<You do not understand the sheer consequences of your actions. You do not look at the larger picture at hand as how can you believe you are deserving of the True Throne?>
WAA!
His body released a unique power that was shockingly connected to an abstruse natural law very few beings grasped.
Even those at the stage of Lilith knew it and grasped it somewhat, but it was not to the extent of utilization!

The Quintessential Kainos Emperor smiled at his words as he affirmed the last vestiges of Apollyon had all but disappeared, his other Clones and Lilith already gone as he now watched the Pocket Dimensional Reality close, his voice ringing out grandly.
"The only picture that matters is the one I am painting. The words of a being playing the role of Emperor after getting help from outside sources...they aren't ones I put much weight on!"

Waves of Quintessence burned in the word of both beings as from CONSTANTINE, his blue eyes began to burn as a sea materialized behind him- a sea filled with an overabundance of natural laws as it threatened to crush everything before it!
And at this same period of time, in an extremely far away location- within the Blacksmith's Forge of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, a change bloomed.

The eyes of the clone facing the oncoming CONSTANTINE lit up brightly as they reflected a scene gazed upon by his Will in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, a scene that showed a particular Forge releasing glorious lights of incandescence.
Lights of completion!
Lights of a much awaited Relic.
Lights...of something with the grandeur of EPOCH!
The Clone saw this scene as his hands stretched out.
"You came at the perfect time. I'll also give you the chance to experience True Quintessence and let you know just how far the gap between us is!"
His hands beckoned.
And a dazzling stellar multicolored light bloomed as the grandeur of blue, crimson and silver were the most pervasive.
Over the eons, there were countless relics that were born and faded over the cruel passage of time.
Countless relics forged by renowned Blacksmiths over many Ages.
But never had there been a Relic that was born under such intricate and perfect conditions like this!
A Relic that was bathed with NULLITY and Mana. And then infused accidentally with the Descent of an Empyral Domain of Nature...it was something born out of pure dreams.
SHING!
Its details were already beginning to bloom in Noah's mind as before the dazzling light could even fade from his hands, it shot out towards the Quantum Emperor.
Obscenely fast.
This was the only thought that would occur when one saw this light that looked like a line cutting through space!
The line of light that had shot out...was a sword.
But it wasn't just any sword, with there being a chain at the end of the multicolored stellar hilt of this sword that was connected to another piece that also left Noah's hands at this moment!
It was ecstatic to see as fantastically, it was in the form of a crescent disk and giving off a holy glare of deadly light.
This crescent disk also left his hand...as he grasped onto the stellar chain that connected the two pieces.

He then began tugging on the chain as the path of the weapons connected to them began to speed up and flutter across the void of space faster than the attacks of anything achievable by the power of even peak Nature Integration existences!

It was so fast...that CONSTANTINE seemingly did not even react to it and in the next instant, the dazzling disk he couldn't even see passed through the midpoint of his body and crossed the dense blue sea behind him.

It was a shocking and unexpected scene as it didn't even seem like an Innate Dimensional Barrier was enacted and broken when this shocking attack passed, with an even more unreasonable action occurring thereafter as the oppressive blue sea behind CONSTANTINE instantly faded as if it never existed!

But the Relic called out didn't stop here as with a being tugging upon their chain, both a stellar sword and a crescent disk seemed like countless sharp lines that tore apart even the void of space as they passed through CONSTANTINE's body countless times.
And each time they passed, they wondrously desegregated a law or decreta as by all means, it was a surreal reality for the Quantum Emperor!

But this being...continued gazing at everything coldly even as thin crimson gold lines began to appear all over his body, portions of his limbs and torso began to separate as he was truly cut into multiple pieces!
WAA!
A dark symphony played as the Eyes of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor turned solemn.
The eyes of the Quantum Emperor retained their grandiose confidence as a foreboding glimmer of light descended!

chapters.title: Chapter 2156 The Spread Of Cataclysm! IV
paragraphs: Noah's Will sent out a command as the lengthening chain that continued to expand and connect two weapons instantly retracted.

A fantastical Relic that had one side show the grandeur of a pristine sword easily surpassing the Sword of Avalon and another end that shine with a crescent disk that could instantly desegregate Nature Integration existences!
It had shown its shocking power today as by all means, the enemy before its master should have perished.
But Quintessential Treasure Cache never triggered.
Even while desegregated with one Vitality near the lowest, no prompt of loot came.
Only the cold gaze of the Quantum Emperor permeated as he only began to show a glimpse of his might!
A terrifying scene occurred in the next moment.
His cut apart limbs began to reconnect.
The allure of Natural Laws and Decreta he was desegregated from reformed as if it was only natural!
His different body pieces reconnected as if the very fabric of Reality was reversed, a unique essence permeating the surroundings as it held traces of an unknown and pristine Fundamental Natural Law!
"Interesting."
Noah's eyes twinkled with light at this as his gaze turned towards a far away direction where a spatial light flashed, the figures of Carciel and other Ancestral Descendants being seen once again.
"Is this your construct that exceeds others in the aspect of Quintessence?"
Noah spoke nonchalantly as his body already began to fade, his Will and voice being the only thing remaining as he formed a devilish smile while he disappeared.
"It shall not remain Quintessential too much longer."
WAP!
Leaving behind these words, he disappeared.
And right after Carciel and other Ancestral Descendants appeared in the surroundings with gazes of anger as they gazed at the blank void of nothingness!
The reformed CONSTANTINE retained his cold look as he spoke out even while in the midst of such beings.
<The location of the displaced Dimension is one full of potent concentration of Natural Laws. We need every single available force scouring the Desolate Mausoleum->
"No."
A golden-haired woman adorned in bone armaments beside Carciel spoke with a rough expression.

"The main goal is to not let a repeat of this Dimension occur. No more Anchors can be pulled as we have to designate forces in the remaining 6 Anchors. True Empress Katya has requested for more forces that will be more than enough to cover the Desolate Mausoleum. We...cannot face a humiliation like this again!"

Words filled with power emanated out as one by one, the Ancestral Descendants began to disappear, leaving behind just the Quantum Emperor as not too long after, the visage of CHARLEMAGNE, Mikados, and a few others began to appear here.
"Sire."
These powerful Rulers gave looks of respect towards CONSTANTINE while gazing with grimness at their surroundings, the beings they were eating homage to nodding as his voice echoed out mesmerizingly.
<User our forces to scour the Desolate Mausoleum. If we can find him, all this comes to a stop. Focus wherever there is a large cluster of natural laws or Enders of Nature...>
Commands began to be given as waves of Destiny and Providence swirled with maddening fervor.
The cerulean eyes of the Quantum Emperor turned and gazed into the unknown, his pupils reflecting countless golden lines at this moment as he continued!
<As for me, I will look for traces across the Myriad Parallel Paths...>
A sense of awe and grandeur rose from him as for the sake of all beings and a brighter future, he moved to apprehend a being that he believed did not fully fathom the consequences of his actions!
The Desolate Mausoleum trembled as one could almost hear a roar of freedom echoing out across its depths.

Natural Laws intensified in concentration and power as Reality became ever so stronger, but this wasn't the only thing that had happened in this period of time as even in the Desolate Mausoleum itself...there were regions where deathly gray fissures of NULLITY stretched out for light years as thousands of Reality fell!
Entropy surged with glory as one could sense the path towards Cataclysm...was only accelerating.
But it wasn't just limited to the Desolate Mausoleum.

Across all 6 remaining Dimensions that Ancestral Descendants had been deployed, fissures of NULLITY carrying the quality of nothingness spread out as the truly powerful beings came to see the auras of Ancestral Descendants carrying out...controlled destruction and Apocalypse.
Paced and controlled Cataclysm as they had a terrifying end goal in mind!
In the bounds of the Prana Dimension.
Beautiful verdant lights covered everything as vegetation and trees that had lived for eons...were wilting in some areas.

All this and more was captured in the eyes of an aged man that floated across the verdant plains of life, watching the gray fissures spreading from afar as this was the most powerful existence in the Prana Dimension- Albus!

After the dissolution of the Dimensional Conclave, he and many others used the chance to retreat amidst the chaos of unreasonable power as they now returned to their homes to see the controlled destruction occurring!
The eyes of Albus were filled with an exuberant life force as he opened his palm at this moment, a flower blooming on it that showed an illusory scene at its very center.
It was the image of the Connate Avalonian Sacred Beast, Guinevere that had sent him a message not too long ago.
A message of possible salvation for not just his Dimension, but all others.
What one needed to do was to just take a leap of faith!
<What do you think, old friend?>
His body sank onto the gorgeous lush Lands below him as his Will connected with the Dimension.
With the Source of Prana!

There were many unknowns in the future to come, but at this moment as the Dimensions entered an accelerated path towards Cataclysm, a silent helping hand was reaching out in an unprecedented move as even with the unreasonable power displayed by beings exceeding all boundaries of power...the result was still unpredictable!

Paced and controlled Cataclysm as they had a terrifying end goal in mind!
In the bounds of the Prana Dimension.
Beautiful verdant lights covered everything as vegetation and trees that had lived for eons...were wilting in some areas.

All this and more was captured in the eyes of an aged man that floated across the verdant plains of life, watching the gray fissures spreading from afar as this was the most powerful existence in the Prana Dimension- Albus!

After the dissolution of the Dimensional Conclave, he and many others used the chance to retreat amidst the chaos of unreasonable power as they now returned to their homes to see the controlled destruction occurring!
The eyes of Albus were filled with an exuberant life force as he opened his palm at this moment, a flower blooming on it that showed an illusory scene at its very center.
It was the image of the Connate Avalonian Sacred Beast, Guinevere that had sent him a message not too long ago.
A message of possible salvation for not just his Dimension, but all others.
What one needed to do was to just take a leap of faith!
<What do you think, old friend?>
His body sank onto the gorgeous lush Lands below him as his Will connected with the Dimension.
With the Source of Prana!

There were many unknowns in the future to come, but at this moment as the Dimensions entered an accelerated path towards Cataclysm, a silent helping hand was reaching out in an unprecedented move as even with the unreasonable power displayed by beings exceeding all boundaries of power...the result was still unpredictable!

chapters.title: Chapter 2157 You All Are Weak! I
paragraphs: Many things could be changed with the hands of men, but time was not one of them.
No matter what one did, time would eventually continue to flow!
Even though a level of controlled and accelerated destruction began across the Barren Lands, time flowed on.
Even though a third Anchor that suppressed the Desolate Mausoleum was removed...time flowed on!
But over the passage of time, many changes could occur as hours after the cataclysmic Dimensional Conclave ended, a level of calm seemed to have settled in on the face of the ongoing Apocalypse.

The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was the place of most calm across all other locations at this moment, with a shocking number of experts within it settling and planning as right now, yet another Conclave was in the process to begin.

The Lands of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality were unique as when one looked at it as a distant observer, they would see the golden layer of the Dream Dimension with its gorgeous waves of sandy light serving as a vast plane at the very bottom, with the royal purple light of Avalon being right above it as countless idyllic floating land masses and purple Cosmos with waterfalls dripping down stretched out across the stellar Lands.
At the top of the Avalon Dimension, a massive purple sword floated with grandiosity as it drenched the Lands below with dense particles of profound light.

And above this, the Crimson light of the newly pulled and reconstructed Apollyon Dimension could be seen as pillars of magma-filled light and crimson cosmos calmly gravitated with grandeur- dense Seas of multicolored essence permeating throughout this Dimension and the one below it!
And then above these three reestablished Dimensions...were an ever increasing cluster of Cosmos that had far surpassed hundreds of millions.

A terrifying feat as Noah had remained in the Infinite Dream pulling more and more Realities to assimilate into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality for so long- not allowing the Dream to end until he actually felt a strain on his soul!

Only then did he stop it as he had to be in the best possible state if any emergencies arose- with the future seeming like it was heavily leaning towards the direction of the strength of one's soul when the concept of Aeonic Soul Value rose.

And after Noah had gazed upon the unique tool that True Empress Katya and all Ancestral Descendants had- a tool that was actually designed by the Ancestors who had first stepped foot outside the Barren Lands in order to allow them to filter out and refine all types of authorities among other uses...he grasped an idea on exactly what type and methodology of power these beings used that was centered around one's Soul...around their Aeonic Soul Value!

His own Soul continued to strengthen to ever greater levels as all the countless existences in the hundreds of millions of Cosmos that had recently joined paid homage to him and gave up portions of their souls.

He also continued to undergo constant refinements from the Natural Laws and Decreta he had, as well as the established Dimensional Realities in his Origin that continued to shine with utmost splendor!
Many things were occurring as in this period of calm where everyone was unsure about the future, only Noah was seeing multiple steps and Paths that could be taken, with many things being completed.

Because of the uncertainty of the future and many other things, a Conclave was beginning in the very center of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality- in the Lands that used to be Noah's old home to be exact!

The stretched-out landmass that used to be the blue planet had changed so drastically that the very earth and skies of these lands pulsed with the Essence of Natural Laws, serene seas of condensed essences swirling across the beautiful skies filled with all sorts of unique Spiritual Beasts.

Towards the center of these lands, three radiant white gold pedestal banquet tables could be seen floating in the skies as two ran in parallel, with the third one standing perpendicular to them as this grand banquet table had the vibrant Throne of Quintessential Tyranny at its very center!

These tables weren't lined with mere seats as radiant thrones could be seen alongside the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny and on the two long banquet tables running alongside each other on the other side.

Tables that had the astounding auras of multiple Dimensional Rulers talking amongst each other while staring at the golden inlaid plates and chalices filled to the brim with stellar drinks pulsing with the Essence of Providence!
This, alongside multicolored fruits releasing waves of the Essence of many Natural Laws caused for a fantastical and never before scene of grandiosity to play out.

Guinevere sat on the seat closest to the perpendicular table where Noah's empty throne could be seen, the Avalonian Dimensional Rulers extending to their own thrones to her left while the Dream Dimensional Rulers were on the other parallel banquet table sitting with regality.

Many of their eyes would at times move away from the incandescent banquet tables and gaze at a point in the skies where a single figure floated like a guard who was protecting this banquet, this guard being none other than The Dimensional Hellion Ruler, Lilith!
Alongside her, radiantly gold Dream Automatons stood in rows as they seemed to serve much more of a decoration than anything else.

Lilith's gaze showed no emotions as one could still see vibrant rage and hatred hidden in her eyes, her presence being something very few could fathom as the Old Dreamer shook his head while watching this scene and spoke out to The Longest Dream.

<If you told me a few days ago that I would be sitting alongside all Dream Dimensional Rulers and Avalon Dimensional Rulers side by side while the Dimensional Deceiver stood watch as a guard...I would've recommended you dream more realistic things.>
WAA!
Yes!

Surreal things were occurring at this moment as apart from the Dream Dimensional Rulers, the perpendicular banquet table that faced all of them had began to fill up its thrones as the exceedingly beautiful figures of Adelaide, Eowyn, Barbatos, Athena, and many others appeared!

They talked amongst each other while gazing at the Rulers with curiosity, but not an ounce of fear or apprehension could be seen as they were also studied by the powerful Nature Integration Realm existences!

chapters.title: Chapter 2158 You All Are Weak! II
paragraphs: Eowyn took the Throne to the right of the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as she sat down and sighed while looking at her father from afar and the rest of the Dimensional Rulers, where even though she was among those who saw exactly how all of this happened, even she couldn't believe it.

To the left of the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the regal visage of Queen Adelaide could be seen as she retained a glorious bearing amidst all of this, where even the Rulers noticed the preferential treatment she was receiving as all others were extremely polite in talking to her or meeting her gaze with nods of respect!
This was, after all, the only woman to bear the progeny of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor at this moment.
Her status was special as The Longest Dream raised his brows at seeing his daughter sit in a similar seat as this being.

Everyone was adorned in intricate dresses and glimmering robes, others adorned in sleek suits as beings like Ezekiel, Kazuhiko, and the Oathkeeper were on the far ends of the thrones adorned in such a manner.

Little Henry was floating on the Throne beside his mother as he was adorned in simple sleek white pants and a loose shirt, his visage looking regal and wild as he truly seemed like a Child of Destiny- his face carrying ridiculous handsomeness!
There were many other beings who all sat and talked amongst each other as they waited for a single being.
For the one man who made all of this possible!
HOONG!
A tantalizing symphony began to play at this juncture as if it was announcing the arrival of someone utterly high in status.
Booming horns blew and drums of power and victory played as above the skies of this ethereal place filled with Seas of multicolored essence, one being appeared as he wasn't alone.
Behind him, 8 other existences releasing even more majestic waves of power appeared as they gave off an inexplicable feel!
8 Clones that looked just like him in grandeur and glory appeared as seven of them were adorned in stellar robes burning with their own unique colors.
They each gave off an aura of a different Dimension as they displayed one of the Dimensional Layers Noah had forged apart from Fantasia and Elysium!

7 of the Dimensional Chassis and 1 True Sanguine Clone came with Noah as he floated towards his throne with grandiosity, 2 other Clones not here as they were still playing their roles as Alexander King with the Primordials and the clone in the Mirror Dimension.

Noah himself was adorned in black and white Emperor's robes as his solidified crown and throne of authority shone radiantly above him, and behind his body...there was something that caused the hearts of the Rulers here to feel a tremendous sense of suffocation!
It floated immediately behind Noah as it was an incandescent blade whose hilt constantly changed colors, its actual blade shining with sharpness as auras of silver-gray and blue radiated around it.
Below the hilt of this blaze, a massive crescent disk leaking out pure white and blue grandeur could be seen as this weapon gave off an aura of ancientness and age!
An aura of EPOCH that nobody here had yet to truly experience!

Such a Relic floated behind Noah along with his Clones as his main body magisterially sat upon the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the Relic and Clones floating behind him with utmost glory as everyone in the surrounding quieted.

The serene waves of essence were the only thing making sounds as all eyes were focused on him and him alone, his face shining with majesty as he laid back on his throne while staring at some of the most powerful beings in these lands.
Thereafter, his voice began to resonate as the symphony of horns and drums faded into the background.
"Some of you here know me by one name or another, and some may not know me at all."
WAA!
As he spoke, he didn't just gaze at the thrones holding Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers, he gazed at other thrones that had illusory images of existences not in this place!
On one throne on the banquet table of the Avalon Dimensional Rulers, the illusory image of Albus from the Prana Dimension could be seen.
In another, the Seeker of Knowledge from the Elysium Dimension could be seen as these were the only two- with no representatives for Fantasia, Quantum, Niflheim, and Mirror present!
Albus and the Seeker of Knowledge had a limited view of the things they heard and saw as Noah took any and all extra precautions just in case, his eyes sharp as he continued.
"I am Noah Osmont, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor...the one that will stand above other Emperors in this Age of Quintessence."
HUUM!
Majesty pulsed and emanated all around as his domineering voice continued!
"But who I am does not matter. What does matter is what I can do in the face of destruction and Apocalypse...and what the rest of you can do as everything is steered towards Cataclysm."
"Unreasonably powerful enemies have come and will continue to come, and all Sources of strength are required to stand against them."

His voice carried a commanding tone and grandeur even as he talked to beings that had lived for billions of years, Barbatos being among others who raised their heads high with smiles on their faces at this scene!

"I was able to save the Dream and Avalon Dimensions with the help of those who listened, and I took Apollyon by force before destruction could overwhelm it. Now, other Dimensions are on the path of an accelerated destruction as the same beings who caused this...will be present to oversee this destruction and prevent any chance of salvaging them. This...is where the strength and power to stand against unreasonable beings is required. But you all...do not have that strength."
The atmosphere changed.
Albus's old eyes shone with solemnity as the Seeker of Knowledge released a radiant light of providence!
"You all are weak...only watching as these unreasonable and unbeatable enemies raze your homes to the ground."
Straightforward words of truth emanated out, with the pupils of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor shining with glory as finished with utmost regality!
"You are weak, yes, but I...can offer you a path to overcome this weakness and at least give you a fighting chance to defend your homes and everything from destruction."
The Essence of Tyranny and Conquest surged with torrential waves that were directed at none other than the Dimensional Rulers!

chapters.title: Chapter 2159 EPOCH! I
paragraphs: You are all weak!
Such a statement was uttered out as immense silence descended, not a single Dimensional Ruler being able to say anything as this was truly the case.

Morgana was among the few who clenched her fists in silence while not being able to say anything, the current reality being so different compared to just days ago when they reigned as the peak of power.
But the rankings of power underwent a great change the moment that Ancestral Descendants began coming down!
Average Nature Integration Realm existences couldn't even grasp their feet.
Dimensional Hellion Rulers and the strongest Dimensional Rulers could only possibly withstand them for mere seconds!
So the words of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor reigned true as thereafter, he told them he could grant them a path to overcome their weaknesses and actually contribute to this unwinnable fight.
His pupils shone with a glint of Tyranny as he continued.
"There is no need for flowery words or going about it in a roundabout way...the path to strength for you all is Fealty."
WAA!
The Throne and crown far above him released rays of authority.
Conquest and Tyranny reigned as while he sat on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, he tapped his hands while emanating his Will.
"I can continue to fight this war alone with you all watching from the sidelines, or you can join in by pledging fealty and achieving sufficient strength to actually fight back against your enemies."
He pointed to the Clones behind him as he continued.

"You can learn my techniques for making many disposable bodies and Clones so you can participate without fear, and each one of you...can be fitted with weapons that can withstand NULLITY, or even relics exceeding the Barren Lands similar to what The Empress pulled out- the allure of EPOCH! All of this and more, the choice is yours."
The Essence of Tyranny mixed in with Quintessential Authority as it bloomed around the Dimensional Rulers here.
Before their eyes, a prompt rose as even these pristine and powerful beings that had lived for billions of years were asked in simple terms...
<Will you pledge Fealty to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor?>
A point of no return.
A line that one had to decide whether to cross or not as they left behind their distinguished titles as Emperors to become vassals of another!
All for the promise of power and weapons that could actually be utilized to stand against the powerful enemies.
Weapons born from MANANIUM and NULLINIUM!
Noah could say this with confidence due to nothing else but the wonders of a new EPOCH Relic he had gained.
An EPOCH Relic...and its capability to multiply Loot.
While the Dimensional Rulers before him were given the chance to make a life defining choice, Noah's eyes reviewed the details of the highest tier Relic he had forged yet!

EPOCH II <Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence>:: A Relic born from sequences of advancements until it reached a pinnacle. Its formation was influenced by materials outside the boundary of the fabric of Reality as well as Quintessential materials at the very pinnacle of the fabric of Reality, giving way to a hybrid that both supersedes Reality and is still supported by it. It still retains its roots and abilities from its prior state, alongside additional features making it worthy of its standing as a Second Rank Epochal Relic that could dictate the direction of an EPOCH. Two parts were assimilated into one to bring the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence into fruition, where the one binding this Relic is granted +50,000% Augmentation to All True Parameter Values passively in its current stage of EPOCH II. The features of <Epochal Decuplicate>, <Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>, <Quintessential Erasure>, and <Empyral Domain of Disorder> are currently unlocked and usable. The assimilation of more materials and relics into the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence shows a possibility of elevating the rank of this EPOCH Relic past the second boundary....
Decuplicate.
Armament Replication.
These were just some of the new and ridiculous features of what RUINATION used to be as now...it was something utterly impossible to understand.
Impossible to understand as its features were just that overbearing!

<Epochal Decuplicate>:: Amongst the auxiliary features of the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence, Decuplicate stands at the very top as it grants the capability to multiply some conceptual ideas, understanding of concepts, and items. The cost to Decuplicate depends on the selected targets as after an initial cost to activate of 200 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality, it may require an additional thousandth of your Aeonic Soul Value or 100% of all of your Aeonic Soul Value. Across the epochs, many concepts and items are capable of undergoing the process of Epochal Decuplicate, while some concepts and items cannot undergo this process no matter what. It is up to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor to grasp the mysteries himself...

<Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>:: Apart from achieving the capability to Decuplicate certain concepts and items, the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence establishes its authority as a True EPOCH II Relic with the capability of Decuplicating itself and its authority, giving birth to 10 EPOCH I [False Epochal Blades of Quintessence] that can be utilized to those bound to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor. A False Epochal Blade of Quintessence grants half the capabilities of a Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence. This ability costs 200 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality and a Hundredth of your Aeonic Soul Value to cast and keep Active for a minute...
Yes!
It was these abilities among others that made Noah confident in greatly elevating the power of the Rulers before him to at least the level of Lilith if not exceeding this!

Epochal Decuplicate promised grand possibilities as all his Loot could be multiplied by 10, and this wasn't all as he could now even do this for the Understanding of Concepts or even Concepts themselves!
He didn't grasp how the Decuplication of concepts fully worked as this would be a surprise for the future to come, but even Epochal Decuplicate was only a single ability to be born out of all this.
The <Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>...was even more balance-breaking!

"You can learn my techniques for making many disposable bodies and Clones so you can participate without fear, and each one of you...can be fitted with weapons that can withstand NULLITY, or even relics exceeding the Barren Lands similar to what The Empress pulled out- the allure of EPOCH!
All of this and more, the choice is yours."
The Essence of Tyranny mixed in with Quintessential Authority as it bloomed around the Dimensional Rulers here.
Before their eyes, a prompt rose as even these pristine and powerful beings that had lived for billions of years were asked in simple terms...
<Will you pledge Fealty to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor?>
A point of no return.
A line that one had to decide whether to cross or not as they left behind their distinguished titles as Emperors to become vassals of another!
All for the promise of power and weapons that could actually be utilized to stand against the powerful enemies.
Weapons born from MANANIUM and NULLINIUM!
Noah could say this with confidence due to nothing else but the wonders of a new EPOCH Relic he had gained.
An EPOCH Relic...and its capability to multiply Loot.
While the Dimensional Rulers before him were given the chance to make a life defining choice, Noah's eyes reviewed the details of the highest tier Relic he had forged yet!
EPOCH II <Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence>:: A Relic born from sequences of advancements until it reached a pinnacle.

Its formation was influenced by materials outside the boundary of the fabric of Reality as well as Quintessential materials at the very pinnacle of the fabric of Reality, giving way to a hybrid that both supersedes Reality and is still supported by it.

It still retains its roots and abilities from its prior state, alongside additional features making it worthy of its standing as a Second Rank Epochal Relic that could dictate the direction of an EPOCH.

Two parts were assimilated into one to bring the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence into fruition, where the one binding this Relic is granted +50,000% Augmentation to All True Parameter Values passively in its current stage of EPOCH II.
The features of <Epochal Decuplicate>, <Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>, <Quintessential Erasure>, and <Empyral Domain of Disorder> are currently unlocked and usable.
The assimilation of more materials and relics into the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence shows a possibility of elevating the rank of this EPOCH Relic past the second boundary....
Decuplicate.
Armament Replication.
These were just some of the new and ridiculous features of what RUINATION used to be as now...it was something utterly impossible to understand.
Impossible to understand as its features were just that overbearing!

<Epochal Decuplicate>:: Amongst the auxiliary features of the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence, Decuplicate stands at the very top as it grants the capability to multiply some conceptual ideas, understanding of concepts, and items.

The cost to Decuplicate depends on the selected targets as after an initial cost to activate of 200 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality, it may require an additional thousandth of your Aeonic Soul Value or 100% of all of your Aeonic Soul Value.
Across the epochs, many concepts and items are capable of undergoing the process of Epochal Decuplicate, while some concepts and items cannot undergo this process no matter what.
It is up to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor to grasp the mysteries himself...

<Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>:: Apart from achieving the capability to Decuplicate certain concepts and items, the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence establishes its authority as a True EPOCH II Relic with the capability of Decuplicating itself and its authority, giving birth to 10 EPOCH I [False Epochal Blades of Quintessence] that can be utilized to those bound to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor.
A False Epochal Blade of Quintessence grants half the capabilities of a Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence.
This ability costs 200 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality and a Hundredth of your Aeonic Soul Value to cast and keep Active for a minute...
Yes!
It was these abilities among others that made Noah confident in greatly elevating the power of the Rulers before him to at least the level of Lilith if not exceeding this!

Epochal Decuplicate promised grand possibilities as all his Loot could be multiplied by 10, and this wasn't all as he could now even do this for the Understanding of Concepts or even Concepts themselves!
He didn't grasp how the Decuplication of concepts fully worked as this would be a surprise for the future to come, but even Epochal Decuplicate was only a single ability to be born out of all this.
The <Emperor's Epochal Armament Replication>...was even more balance-breaking!

chapters.title: Chapter 2160 EPOCH! II
paragraphs: He could adorn 10 Existences with EPOCH Relics as the extent of power they could release would at least be able to defend against the Tyranny of the Ancestral Descendants.
This power was just one among the many things that Noah had that made him confident in saying the things he did.
In making these extremely powerful beings pledge fealty as they left their roles as Emperors to become Vassals!
The serene and beautiful atmosphere was silent as waves of radiant seas of essence were the only things that could be heard.
Destiny and Providence swirled with magnificence as it didn't take too long after the prompt rose before the eyes of the Dimensional Rulers for some to already make the choice.
And uniquely, the first one to do so was actually none other than Guinevere as she understood Noah the most out of all other Rulers here!
A glimmer of light shone from her as a thin line shot out from her to Noah, her eyes being covered by a royal purple light as she nodded towards him calmly while her voice emanated out.

<You kept your end of the bargain and saved Avalon, and you are the only one with the capability of saving other Anchors while standing against the Ancestors that have abandoned us. I have a great deal of pride, yes, but I know what to do when an obvious path of destruction or salvation lies before me.>
WAA!
Her voice was mesmerizing to hear as it wasn't just meant for Noah.

It reverberated in the minds of all Rulers here as this exceedingly beautiful being that stood over the top of Avalon gave a nod of recognition while allowing the Essence of the Quintessential Tyranny to enter her very source!

<I commend you for being the Emperor that rose above others to have reached this point in this Age...and I hope this is not the highest you can reach. Not just for your sake, but for the sake of us all...>

Incandescence bloomed from her as she became the first to pledge fealty, her eyes still showing the same regality and coldness as she seemed to be thinking a million thoughts when she finished her words- her eyes bright as she sat back down on her throne!

Noah gave back this nod of respect as he then turned to stare coldly at all the rest, his eyes particularly resting on Morgana as if he wanted to watch every passing nanosecond that she fought with her heart before she made the inevitable choice.
The words of Guinevere still resounded in their minds as after her choice was made...
<I'm truly getting too old for this...>
The Dreamer of Providence sighed as he accepted the light of Tyranny to wrap around his body as well!

The Longest Dream stared towards Eowyn and etched the dazzling golden hair of his daughter into his eyes, seeing her expression towards him as while staring deep into her eyes, this being also accepted the light of Tyranny!
One by one, brilliant radiance shone on all the Dream Dimensional Rulers as thereafter, the figures of the Avalon Dimensional Rulers began to illuminate.

Arthus gave a glance to his son from afar as his body glowed with the light of Tyranny, with Noah's eyes still focused on Morgana coldly as with her lips trembling at this inevitable choice...even this utter beauty had to pledge fealty as the tyrannical light sank into her as well!

A smile rose from Noah's lips at this as even while pledging fealty, Morgana still gazed towards him with a light of defiance in her eyes as with her...all the Rulers present truly took the unheard of stop to pledge fealty to a single being of Age.

The illusory screens that showed Albus from the Prana Dimension and the Seeker of Knowledge from Elysium glimmered as the latter had tendrils of Providence swirling around her, her voice strong as it emanated out across spacetime.
<I trust in Providence...and anyone that has bound its Source is one who is worthy to lead us. All of the Elysium will heed your call.>
WAA!
Waves of utmost glory whipped as it lastly came to one of the oldest beings here- Albus gazing at the scenes he could from a distinct location in the Prana Dimension as his aged eyes seemed tired.
Tired, and yet full of light as he turned to stare at the expanse of verdant greenery around him and the far away rifts of NULLITY spreading out.
<Emperors rise and fall...I have seen this many times over the Ages.>
His voice was filled with life as he spoke, all Wills gathering to listen as it seemed tendrils of wisdom were flowing out!
<I have seen it many times, but I have yet to see an Emperor denying the Will of the Ancestors. I am curious to see whether you will be successful when even Reality itself could not deny their Will.>
HOONG!
His words were boisterous as even the fabric of Reality itself seethed at their provocation!
But the choice in his words was clear as across the folds of space, Noah's will shot out as his eyes focused on this being- his essence of Tyranny landing on Albus as this being also accepted it!
An existence so old and with power that even matched CHARLEMAGNE was also bound to become his Vassal as he took many Emperors under his banner today!
And it was a worthy feat.
It was a notable one.

Back in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his Main Body sitting on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny experienced a shocking rise in aura potency and authority as the very Essence of Quintessence began to spin with torrential wildness around him.
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>
<A significant percentage of the most powerful existences within the Age of Quintessence has been achieved!>
<The backbone of your Throne is going towards completion!>
<The True Throne of Quintessence is beginning to call out to you!>
