chapters.title: Chapter 2170 Boundaries! II
paragraphs: Across the spacetime continuum.
Within the Boundary Between Realities.
The visage of a single man adorned in a white robe could be seen surrounded by the VOID, his blue eyes being the only thing releasing a point of light in the surroundings as he came to a stop!
This was because his eyes were reflecting a burst of information that came from the very fabric of Reality.
<Another Reality Altering Construct has exceeded limitation and become Quintessential.>
<Your Reality Altering Construct is no longer Quintessential.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has quintessentially decreased.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has quintessentially decreased.>
Droves of information that caused his cerulean eyes to release shocking rays of light!

The same being he was seeking in the Desolate Mausoleum...had somehow gone to exceed the construct he created with the aid of Ancestral Descendants. With the aid of an existence with a unique Boundary of Constructs!
An existence that even after he used all of his authority to seek in the Myriad Parallel Paths...he could not find him.
He only saw the scene of darkness spreading as Apocalyptic Parallel Paths were increasing in number.
And yet the existence he sought was nowhere to be found across these paths.
CONSTANTINE gazed at the disappearing flows of information silently as his head raised up.
He gazed at the Interminable darkness all around him as he wondered.
Would Quintessence truly slip past his grasp in an Age that was his to reign in?
WAA!
It was a question that did not have an answer, with the future remaining unknown as his visage released even more authoritative light while he continued his search!
<The Infinite Forge has become Quintessential in the Age of Quintessence.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>
The backbone of the Throne absorbed incandescent rays of light as at this moment, it truly couldn't be called a backbone anymore.
It was seemingly beginning to materialize into something else as the True Authority of Quintessence could be felt bubbling with surging waves and building up to a crescendo!

Noah was achieving Quintessence in all fields as one of the few things remaining was his Physique being Quintessential as well, something that would be easily achieved after the formation of another Dimensional Layer!
So in the midst of all this, he gazed at the Reality Altering Construct that he had achieved Quintessence in.

<Infinite Forge>::...Every 24 Hours, the following Loot will be passively generated in the Infinite Forge that the user can enter to remove or allow to passively accumulate over time: <25,000 Transcendent True Vitality Flasks>(100% Chance to Generate), <125,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(100% Chance to Generate), <1,250,000 Golden Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(100% Chance to Generate), <25,000,000x Ingots of MANANIUM>(100% Chance to Generate), <25,000,000x Ingots of NULLINIUM>(100% Chance to Generate),<2,500x Random Transcendent DHARMA Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <2,500x Random Absolute Dimensional Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Random Connate Dimensional Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Random Transcendent Skill Tree of a True Emperor>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Modus Operandi of Previous Ages>(100% Chance to Generate), <10x Random ZENITH Dimensional Lineage>(100% Chance to Generate),<10x Random ZENITH Reality Lineage>(100% Chance to Generate), <500,000 All Source Enhancers>(100% Chance to Generate), <500,000 Shards of Concept Modifiers>(100% Chance to Generate)<10x Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystal>(50% Chance to Generate), <1x Absolute Connate Reality Relic>(50% Chance to Generate), <1x Absolute Connate Dimensional Relic>(50% Chance to Generate), <2,500x Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(25% Chance to Generate), <100x Aeonic Soul Pills>(25% Chance to Generate)<1x Blueprint of the Automaton Boundary Modulator>(25% Chance to Generate), <1x Random Lineage Boundary of Extremity(1% Chance to Generate)...
Utter Quintessence presented itself before his eyes.
He had spent 500,000 All Source Enhancers for its elevation, and yet every day, it would spit back the same number of Loot to him...along with a ridiculous number of many others!
An addition of a myriad of more Loot.
From 250 Obsidian Panaceas, the number became 125,000 every 24 hours.
From a .05% Chance to Generate 50 Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas, it was now a 25% Chance to get 2,500 of them!
A 25% Chance to Generate a Blueprint of the Automaton Boundary Modulator! Aeonic Soul Pills! And even a minuscule 1% Chance to attain a random Lineage Boundary of Extremity!
All of this...every 24 hours.
A constant cycle.
"Worthy to be a Quintessential Construct of this Age."

Noah's Will emanated out grandly as he spoke to himself with a nod of acknowledgment, his eyes looking at the few minutes remaining before the Cycle of the Infinite Forge reset and he was granted the boundless types of loot within it.
He looked at the resource to come his way as well as the ones he had currently as his Will gave another command.
"Begin the formation of the Eighth Dimensional Layer. Designate it to be Fantasia."
WAA!
He began with the formation of another layer that would cement his foundation even further.

A layer that for him to form, he required over 3.5 Million All Source Enhancers...or close to 18 Million Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas as forming this Layer required 128 times more resources than the 7th Dimensional Layer!
This would have been a daunting number a day ago with many questions as to how he could possibly come up with such a number.
But that was a day ago.
Now, he would soon be getting 500,000 All Source Enhancers from the Infinite Forge that he...had not placed through a round of Epochal Decuplicate.
So truly...he was about to achieve 5,000,000 All Source Enhancers within the next few minutes!
It was frankly ridiculous and utterly balance breaking for what was about to happen to even be possible.
But for the sake of overcoming Unreasonably powerful enemies...Noah had to be even more unreasonable and balance breaking!

sentences.text: Across the spacetime continuum.
Within the Boundary Between Realities.
The visage of a single man adorned in a white robe could be seen surrounded by the VOID, his blue eyes being the only thing releasing a point of light in the surroundings as he came to a stop!
This was because his eyes were reflecting a burst of information that came from the very fabric of Reality.
<Another Reality Altering Construct has exceeded limitation and become Quintessential.>
<Your Reality Altering Construct is no longer Quintessential.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has quintessentially decreased.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has quintessentially decreased.>
Droves of information that caused his cerulean eyes to release shocking rays of light!
The same being he was seeking in the Desolate Mausoleum...had somehow gone to exceed the construct he created with the aid of Ancestral Descendants.
With the aid of an existence with a unique Boundary of Constructs!
An existence that even after he used all of his authority to seek in the Myriad Parallel Paths...he could not find him.
He only saw the scene of darkness spreading as Apocalyptic Parallel Paths were increasing in number.
And yet the existence he sought was nowhere to be found across these paths.
CONSTANTINE gazed at the disappearing flows of information silently as his head raised up.
He gazed at the Interminable darkness all around him as he wondered.
Would Quintessence truly slip past his grasp in an Age that was his to reign in?
WAA!
It was a question that did not have an answer, with the future remaining unknown as his visage released even more authoritative light while he continued his search!
<The Infinite Forge has become Quintessential in the Age of Quintessence.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>
The backbone of the Throne absorbed incandescent rays of light as at this moment, it truly couldn't be called a backbone anymore.
It was seemingly beginning to materialize into something else as the True Authority of Quintessence could be felt bubbling with surging waves and building up to a crescendo!

Noah was achieving Quintessence in all fields as one of the few things remaining was his Physique being Quintessential as well, something that would be easily achieved after the formation of another Dimensional Layer!
So in the midst of all this, he gazed at the Reality Altering Construct that he had achieved Quintessence in.

<Infinite Forge>::...Every 24 Hours, the following Loot will be passively generated in the Infinite Forge that the user can enter to remove or allow to passively accumulate over time: <25,000 Transcendent True Vitality Flasks>(100% Chance to Generate), <125,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(100% Chance to Generate), <1,250,000 Golden Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(100% Chance to Generate), <25,000,000x Ingots of MANANIUM>(100% Chance to Generate), <25,000,000x Ingots of NULLINIUM>(100% Chance to Generate),<2,500x Random Transcendent DHARMA Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <2,500x Random Absolute Dimensional Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Random Connate Dimensional Relic>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Random Transcendent Skill Tree of a True Emperor>(100% Chance to Generate), <50x Modus Operandi of Previous Ages>(100% Chance to Generate), <10x Random ZENITH Dimensional Lineage>(100% Chance to Generate),<10x Random ZENITH Reality Lineage>(100% Chance to Generate), <500,000 All Source Enhancers>(100% Chance to Generate), <500,000 Shards of Concept Modifiers>(100% Chance to Generate)<10x Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystal>(50% Chance to Generate), <1x Absolute Connate Reality Relic>(50% Chance to Generate), <1x Absolute Connate Dimensional Relic>(50% Chance to Generate), <2,500x Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas>(25% Chance to Generate), <100x Aeonic Soul Pills>(25% Chance to Generate)<1x Blueprint of the Automaton Boundary Modulator>(25% Chance to Generate), <1x Random Lineage Boundary of Extremity(1% Chance to Generate)...
Utter Quintessence presented itself before his eyes.
He had spent 500,000 All Source Enhancers for its elevation, and yet every day, it would spit back the same number of Loot to him...along with a ridiculous number of many others!
An addition of a myriad of more Loot.
From 250 Obsidian Panaceas, the number became 125,000 every 24 hours.
From a .05% Chance to Generate 50 Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas, it was now a 25% Chance to get 2,500 of them!
A 25% Chance to Generate a Blueprint of the Automaton Boundary Modulator!
Aeonic Soul Pills!
And even a minuscule 1% Chance to attain a random Lineage Boundary of Extremity!
All of this...every 24 hours.
A constant cycle.
"Worthy to be a Quintessential Construct of this Age."

Noah's Will emanated out grandly as he spoke to himself with a nod of acknowledgment, his eyes looking at the few minutes remaining before the Cycle of the Infinite Forge reset and he was granted the boundless types of loot within it.
He looked at the resource to come his way as well as the ones he had currently as his Will gave another command.
"Begin the formation of the Eighth Dimensional Layer.
Designate it to be Fantasia."
WAA!
He began with the formation of another layer that would cement his foundation even further.

A layer that for him to form, he required over 3.5 Million All Source Enhancers...or close to 18 Million Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas as forming this Layer required 128 times more resources than the 7th Dimensional Layer!
This would have been a daunting number a day ago with many questions as to how he could possibly come up with such a number.
But that was a day ago.
Now, he would soon be getting 500,000 All Source Enhancers from the Infinite Forge that he...had not placed through a round of Epochal Decuplicate.
So truly...he was about to achieve 5,000,000 All Source Enhancers within the next few minutes!
It was frankly ridiculous and utterly balance breaking for what was about to happen to even be possible.
But for the sake of overcoming Unreasonably powerful enemies...Noah had to be even more unreasonable and balance breaking!

chapters.title: Chapter 2171 Boundaries! III
paragraphs: In the Niflheim Dimension.
The skies and earth that were normally cold and dreary were even more deathly to be in, with the vast majority of the Undead roaming around silently at this moment.

After Lilith's war and subsequent loss of control and death of so many Rulers, the chain of Command was nonexistent and even further abolished when the rifts of NULLITY began to spread and destroy the Dimension under the hands of Ancestral Descendants.
This was a Dimension that was currently being overseen by the forces of Yvonne, her Legion of 96 spread between Niflheim, Mirror, and the Prana Dimension!
And Yvonne herself with all her grandiosity was at the center of Niflheim with 32 Ancestral Descendants from her legion stretched out around her.
Yvonne the Conqueror!

This was her title that showed her power as she expanded the Boundary of Death towards Extremity while achieving shocking results, but even she was gazing around coldly and carefully at this moment after the blanketing of the VOID that covered everything!

Her dazzling black and gray hair illuminated and came to life as she was adorned with an Obsidian skull that covered her head, her pupils in the form of skulls radiating a deathly light as her Automaton Boundary Modulator rotated dimly around her.
She couldn't communicate with anyone, nor could she leave her post.
All of the Ancestral Descendants knew this as the protocol as this wasn't the first time they came across the VOID!
They had to face what was coming and follow the same plan of overseeing the destruction of the Dimensions and Reality without any more Anchors being removed.
So Yvonne spread out her Soul as much as she could with the Boundary of Death, those around her doing the same as they prepared for anything.
And no sooner than a few minutes passed after the VOID blanketed everything...
HOOONG!
Space split and fractured as a billowing aura of a lone being stepped out not too far from their forces.
"Attention!"

Yvonne bellowed out coldly as all her forces surged to surround the opening rift in an instant, their bodies blazing with maddening reality cracking power as they gazed forth coldly and with ferocity!
And when the rift closed with the identity of the existence revealing itself...
BOOOM!
The auras around Yvonne and all her forces blared as behind them dark skulls appeared that released layers of dark defensive light to wrap around each of them.

This...was an instinctive move as they instantly deployed one of their more powerful defensive measures- their bodies becoming wrapped with the protective aura of death as massive illusory skulls floated above their heads!
This was an instinctive reaction because the moment the being out of the rift became clear, their strong souls could sense and smell a certain scent they were very familiar with.
A being that smelled of the Lineage of their True Enemies!
And an affirmation of the spread of the VOID that just occurred.
Their Lineage was a unique one.
Generally, the more powerful a race was, the harder it was for them to reproduce.
This was not the case for them!
They propagated at speeds far faster than some of the weakest races while their Bloodline was so powerful and potent that it stood above many others!
It was why outside the Barren Lands, they were the ones in control of the farthest reaches of lands and resources.
They were known as....
"NOBLESSE..."

Yvonne uttered out with utmost distaste as the magisterial humanoid visage of the unveiled existence floated while surrounded by her forces with his hands behind his back, his titanic eyes gazing around him with a carefree expression.
NOBLESSE!
This was the Lineage that the Ancestors came across outside the Barren Lands that caused them to despair!
A Lineage whose name alone exemplified superiority, ennoblement, and a profound sense of elevation above other Lineages!
Yvonne could feel her body pulsing with alarms as she spoke while the skull above her head spat out luminous flames!
"I've never seen a NOBLESSE actually hiding their true form that gives them so much pride. Are you a runt that managed to bypass the folds of Reality? How many more of you are here?"
She spoke to destabilize the mind of this being while also trying to figure out how the NOBLESSE Has discovered the Barren Lands- and how many were actually here.
All of these were crucial questions as towards such a provocation, the titanic form of the unveiled existence actually let out a burst of booming laughter.
WAA

A burst of laughter that caused the fabric of Reality to tremble and shatter, with this being answering not with words, but with his actions as his massive visage began to release rays of black light.
A black light that caused Yvonne's eyes to sink!
His form began to change.
Its massive humanoid stature shrunk down and became more refined, an explosive musculature still being seen as radiant Obsidian robes draped over his wide back.
On his wrists, a dazzling Obsidian Halo could be seen spinning vibrantly on each hand as the same colored Halos could be seen around his ankles!
And when one gazed above the broad muscular chest covered by the incandescent obsidian robe, they would see the most exquisitely handsome existence in the Barren Lands.

His face was overflowing with regality and grandeur as he would out those calling themselves Emperors to shame- his nose sharp and his eyes piercing as his whole face was illuminated with a stellar black hue!
The reason for this was the appearance of four radiant obsidian Halos around his head- one in the back, one on top, and two on the right and left sides of his head!
These Halos released a light of majesty and power as they seemed to constantly be funneling waves of essence over this being.
Yvonne gazed at this as her heart turned somber, her voice emanating out grandly.
"An 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE..."
WAA!
4 Obsidian Halos around his head. One on each of his hands and legs.
An 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE!

chapters.title: Chapter 2172 Boundaries! IV
paragraphs: An 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE!

Just one Echelon off of becoming one of the most powerful NOBLESSE in the Obsidian Stage! Such was the being Yvonne had to face as normally, this was the type of existence that Yvonne and multiple other Commanders had to face on the battlefield to guarantee victory.
It was an utterly terrifying being to come across alone.
But...the situation was slightly different due to where they were as in the Barren Lands, things might just play out differently than expected!
The Natural Laws here bound everyone equa-
"You think a chance of survival is possible due to the bindings of Natural Laws."
Her eyes constricted as her thoughts were stopped by his cold and resonant words!
The 4 Halos around his head illuminated as they showed his smile of majesty and brutality, his eyes being shown as they...held no pupils.
Pure blackness was all that could be seen in this being's eyes as they seemed like focal points of piercing singularities!
"I will tell you to throw those thoughts out of the window if you wish to survive the next few seconds, Little Rabbit."
BOOOM!
The eyes of this being burst with light as Yvonne made a move right after, her body releasing a deathly smoke of light as around her- terrifying clusters of Undead began to appear!
"Release all your Legions and maintain your distance! The aim is defense and containment!"
Yvonne bellowed out her command as the Automaton Boundary Modulators were not working anymore.

The bindings of Natural Laws were pressing down even more tightly around her along with the oppression of the VOID, but she knew what she had to do as around her- Variations of many Races of Undead appeared and formed an ever expanding Legion!
She said the goals were Defense and Containment.
She didn't even place the possibility of them actually defeating an 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE on the table until reinforcements came, and she knew that the VOID had to have a time limit.
Once it was lifted and this being's power was a bit more used up...they would be able to move freely and even stand a possibility to erase a commanding NOBLESSE here!
And someone like her and her Legion who could summon droves of Aeon Undead...were the best at containment and stalling for a long period of time!
HOOONG!

Boundless shadows bloomed around her and her party of 32 as the encirclement of the 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE seemed like a constantly expanding deathly mass stretching out for light years- millions of Aeon Undead and Apparitions appearing as the Boundary of Death was put on full display.
The capability to summon truly powerful Undead who could release Aeonic Damage Values with deathly precision.
The capability to delay one's demise and use the Boundary of Death in unfathomable ways!
And yet the being who faced all this...smiled ever brighter as he breathed in the smell of death, his magnetic voice echoing out.
"The Boundary of Death...one I am familiar with. Let us see how far you are towards Extremity."
An Obsidian light flashed from his body.
SHIING!
And around him, deathly waves of energy erupted as different Tiers of Aeon Undead began to rise freely!
Waves of Entropy whipped around madly in this region of fracturing Reality as a shocking battle bloomed, the fate of the Barren Lands hinging on the many Nexus Events about to unfold!
In the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature.
The eyes of Noah's main body rose up amidst his Dual Cultivation and attaining of unique Lineages from the Dimensional Rulers before him.
He was doing many things at once, with his main body well in the process of forging the Eighth Dimensional Layer by first utilizing Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas.
Yet at this moment, a portion of his consciousness disappeared at this juncture as a prompt had risen before him!
<24 Hours have passed since the last Generation of The Infinite Forge, would you like to receive the generated loot?>
A prompt that he immediately agreed with.
And one that only took a portion of his soul this time into the Lemniscate Epitaph releasing rays of radiant light!
When his soul came to be again, he found himself back in the radiant domain filled with golden luminescence and grandeur.

His will could feel a floor of crystalline golden stellar liquid that had mountains of Loot rising throughout it, with this light stretching out endlessly and converging around a massive spinning golden Lemniscate Epitaph.

A spinning golden infinity symbol that released vibrant waves of loot light, the two circles within it covered by a luminescent golden film of light that began to shine at this moment while the symbol spun!
<The Loot of a 24 Hour Cycle shall be Generated>

Similar to before, Noah's will began to see shining bundles of loot light fly out from the spinning Infinity Symbol and cascade over the liquid gold floor that already had mountains of loot- the prompts beginning to rain down as Providence shone.
<25,000 Transcendent True Vitality Flasks have been generated.>
<125,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas have been generated.>
<1,250,000 Golden Dimensional Reality Panaceas have been generated.>
<25,000,000x Ingots of MANANIUM have been generated>
How could it even be described?
A breathtaking scene was taking place as breaking all possibilities of balance, droves of loot rained down from the golden Lemniscate in the halcyon skies in obscene numbers.

Before the incandescent allure of Flasks and the raining Panaceas even ended, the skies became painted blue by the grandeur of 25 Million metalloid and radiant cerulean Ingots of MANANIUM raining down!
And this...was only the beginning of the Infinite Forge's production today.
It was a rain of loot and grandiosity that caused the hearts of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor to fill with boundless joy and contentment!
<Author's Note>

<Empyral Domain of Disorder>:: A skill born due to the confluence of the laws on nature during the elevation of RUINATION. It allows the holder of the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence to release a domain that destabilizes all conceptual forms of Reality, and on some viable concepts, grants the opposite result. The casting of all abilities are interrupted in this domain as only those who are highly proficient in essence utilization are able to cast abilities through unique Boundaries or Paths. The cast Empyral Domain of Disorder can cover a region as small as a few meters to the size of Planes depending on the cost paid. This ability costs 300 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality and a Hundredth of your Aeonic Soul Value to cast...

chapters.title: Chapter 2173 The Ambrosia Of Loot! I
paragraphs: The halcyon skies within the space of the Infinite Forge became painted a gorgeous blue briefly as millions of Ingots of MANANIUM rained down to form stellar cerulean mountains.
And not long after that...
<25,000,000x Ingots of NULLINIUM have been generated>
Vibrant silver gray lights rained down soon after as obscene amounts of NULLITY also cascaded down into their own mountains!

All of these were ecstatic to see as with them, Noah could form a great number of powerful Relics...or he could funnel a majority of these materials into the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence to continue elevating RUINATION!
The answer for this was clear as many of the ridiculous things that were about to happen would only be made viable due to RUINATION.
So even as the obscene allure of loot rained down, Noah had already designated its usage long ago!
And just as the Ingots of NULLINIUM finished raining down, an even more unforgettable scene bloomed.
From the buzzing golden Lemniscate in the halcyon skies, Transcendent DHARMA Relics began to rain down.
They released glorious radiance as stellar painted swords, bows, hammers, armor, helms...a variety of armaments rained down with a fantastical light of loot!
<2,500x Random Transcendent DHARMA Relics have been generated.>
And even before they finished cascading down...
<The Connate Dimensional Relic Life Splitter has been generated.>
<The Connate Dimensional Relic Elysium Breastplate has been generated.>
<The Connate Dimensional Relic Quantum Needle has been generated.>
<The Connate Dimensional Relic....>
Even more glorious items that were higher in ranking came down by the tens, the prompts washing over Noah's eyes as he truly felt...like he had arrived at his happiest place.
At a place of constant loot raining down as the Will of this Quintessential Kainos Emperor became humbled at the ambrosia of Loot light raining down!
He reflected where he had come from all those months ago when he was entering mere dungeons termed [Ape's Paradise] and [Goblin King's Abode] looking for items and skill books, and now...
He had the most premium items raining down from a reality Altering Construct that he had built himself!

And loot such as this would continue to rain down every 24 hours for as long as he lived, but he didn't think he would ever get tired from looking at the grandeur of loot light coming down for the days to come.
50x Random Connate Dimensional Relics came down as even before they finished landing on the piles of mountainous loot...
<The Transcendent Skill Tree of the True Emperor of the Age of Fate has been generated.>
<The Transcendent Skill Tree of the True Emperor of the Age of Chaos has been generated.>
<The Transcendent Skill Tree of the True Emperor of the Age of Light has been generated...>
Amalgamations of concepts in the form of titanic ancient tomes of light appeared, numbering at 50 in total as these...Noah planned to learn and see if he could draw any inspiration from.

But they would be going to the Soul Library as he would have Guinevere, Eowyn, The Longest Dream...all Rulers under him- he would have them grasp techniques of past True Emperors along with his own self designed skill trees!
This was the thought at hand as multicolored tomes rained down with glory.

Thereafter, tens of unique Modus Operandi stretched out across the Ages also came down in the form of ancient tomes, and then the points of loot light that shone like bright stars began to cascade down.
<The ZENITH Apollyon Dimensional Lineage of the Imperial Orc Daemon Emperor has been generated.>
<The ZENITH Fantasia Dimensional Lineage of the Celestial Whale Zaxa has been generated.>
<The ZENITH Dream Dimensional Lineage of the Nightmare Ender has been generated.>
Lineages that Noah would absorb into his own began to bloom as with these...the number was 10 for ZENITH Dimensional and 10 for ZENITH Reality Lineages!

Among the few things Noah could truly get a chance to Decuplicate, these unique Lineages were not one of them as the bundle of light holding the blood of the Celestial Whale Zaxa for example...multiplying this by 10 would just increase the amount of Blood Noah could absorb to attain the Lineage and not result in anything else drastic.
But it was still 20 Unique ZENITH Lineages falling onto his lap as for these...he would see if he would be able to touch the boundary above ZENITH for his own Bloodline.

And the moment the blobs of starlight ended falling from the skies, they were replaced with the fantastical allure of none other than the multicolored stellar glows of Enhancers and Shards of Concept Modifiers raining down onto the already rising loot mountains.
<500,000x All Source Enhancers have been generated.>
<500,000x Shards of Concept Modifiers have been generated.>
Glorious multicolored grandeur came down as after this, the Loot that had a 50% Chance or lower to Generate every 24 hours appeared!
<Providence has shone upon you.>
And surges of Providence cascaded down as a blinding point of a Singularity bloomed from the golden spinning Lemniscate.
<10x Natural Decretum Complete Understanding Crystals have been generated.>
Understanding Crystals that Noah could multiply to gain 100 rained from the skies as they were followed by...
<The Absolute Connate Reality Relic Empyral Shield of the Entropy has been generated.>
<The Absolute Connate Dimensional Relic Helm of Fantasia has been generated.>
Two relics akin to the Sword of Avalon came down in a serene show of wonder, but they weren't what caught Noah's eyes the most.
It was the fact that the golden skies of this space began to turn a shade of crimson.
A shade that caused his Heart to palpate as hundreds of crimson singularities formed from halcyon lemniscate as each was the size of one of the mountains of loot already forming below!
It was the appearance of Loot that caused Noah's multiple Hearts to cry out and for his Origin to tremble!
<2,500x Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas have been generated.>
The allure of stellar crimson gold loot light came to wash over everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 2174 The Ambrosia Of Loot! II
paragraphs: <2,500x Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas have been generated.>
The Crimson color they held superseded any version of red Noah had seen before.
They seemed like millions of thin rivers of crimson Realities coalescing together to form a massive circular Panacea- a panacea that made itself look like the very fruit of Reality!

The aura it gave off caused his forming 8th Dimensional Layer to tremble and seek this Panacea fervently, but he held it back as a resource like this was reserved for the last and final Dimensional Layer which would be Elysium!
But these wonders came down with fantastical glory as more prompts unfurled.
<The most Quintessential Loot obtainable by the current state of Absolute Loot Authority has been generated.>
WAA!
The most Quintessential Loot.

Forget about anything else that had the chance to come after the Crimson Dimension Reality Panacea- it was granted the accolade of the Most Quintessential Loot attainable to him under his current Absolute Loot Authority.
And this...was a prompt that caused Noah's soul to release a pulse of spatial light as everything around him slowed and came to a halt.
He steeled his heart while gazing at the golden skies that dripped with the ambrosia of Loot light- at the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas that were calling out to him!
And he wondered.

He had been debating how to proceed forward in the expansion of his power- and exactly which area he wanted to expand his authority as he reached the same stage of power of Boundary Expansion that Ancestral Descendants had attained.
Yes.
Boundary Expansion!

This was the alternate Realm that the Ancestors termed when they left behind Nature Integration- and it was for beings who did not integrate with Nature as instead, they expanded the Boundary of concepts and authorities!
They did all this with a singular aim to achieve a stage that their True Enemies had achieved- a stage coming after Boundary Expansion as it was known as EXTREMITY.
When an existence reached the absolute Extremity of a Boundary as it could not even be expanded any further.
Boundary Expansion, and then EXTREMITY!
All of the Ancestral Descendants that came into the Barren Lands were at the stage of Boundary Expansion, including the unveiled existence that had deployed the VOID.
If any of them were at the stage of EXTREMITY, Noah and everyone else would have just had to pack their bags and wait for slaughter.
But the stage of Boundary Expansion was attainable as Noah just had to choose a concept and expand it!
The question came to him on exactly what he should expand the limits of.

He could utilize the Shards of Concept Modifiers to increase the Augmentations of Natural Laws and Decreta, or expand the Boundary of his Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques, or even the True Authority of Quintessence that was calling out to him and coiling around his Throne!
But now as he gazed at the ambrosia of Loot cascading down...
He questioned how he got where he was.
And the answer was Loot.
His ability to get Loot that could then be multiplied in Quality and Quantity multiple times over.
The Absolute Loot Authority...that granted him what he needed the most.
Of course, he had to have had the offensive and defensive power to kill- but there were many more powerful beings who had nowhere near his speed of progression!
The critical factor remained Loot!
And in a construct like the Infinite Forge, he didn't even need to fight anyone to gain the most fundamental forms of loot.
This was because before his very eyes, he was attaining Panaceas that no enemy had dropped yet.

Of course, he still understood that power was at the basis of everything as the advent of the All Source Enhancers and RUINATION who could Decuplicate Loot and make everything that was happening right now a possibility did stem from the Loot of the enemies that Noah killed in the past!
So there would have to be a balance in the distribution, but at this moment...Noah's Heart was leaning towards Expanding the Path of Loot. The Boundary of Loot!
He wanted to elevate Absolute Loot Authority to unimaginable levels.
He wanted to attain Loot multiple times above the killed enemy in quality and quantity!
He wanted his very cells to drink the ambrosia of Loot every waking moment!
He wanted even more of this type of Loot where even by doing nothing...it simply came to him.
HOOONG!
His thoughts were wild and vibrant as Providence surged with maddening fervor- seemingly edging him on as he smiled.

His soul had formed a corporeal form that reached out towards the descending Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas as one of them landed on his hands, his eyes vibrant as they saw through this fantastical treasure.

<Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea>:: A Quintessential Loot brought to fruition by the authority of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor in his bid to enact a grand foundation. This Loot serves as the final piece required to complete the last stage of progression for a type of Quintessential Foundation in the shortest period of time. Its stage nears the treasures that the Quintessential Kainos Emperor has just begun to glimpse from the information of things outside the Barren Lands, with a single Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas being equivalent to 100,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas. It is what is required for the completion of a grand foundation. It is what is needed. And so here it is!
WAA!
A glorious and precise description!
And one that caused Noah to smile brilliantly when reading it.
This was because the formation of the final Dimensional Layer would have required Obsidian Dimensional Panaceas in the Billions.

The resources became greater and greater the higher up one went, and after the required resources were multiplied by 128 for the Eighth Dimensional Layer, the resources for the Ninth Dimensional Reality were 256x those required for the Layer behind it!
But with the advent of the Crimson Dimensional Panaceas and the fact that Noah could multiply them tenfold...
"2 days."
His Will was luminous and shining with incandescence as he said these words.
2 days!
He would only need 2 days as the next collection of the Infinite Forge after another 24 hours passed...would grant him everything he needed to fully complete his Ninth Dimensional Reality!
All without touching or fighting to the death against a single enemy!

chapters.title: Chapter 2175 The Ambrosia Of Loot! III
paragraphs: The path towards the completion of his Foundation became clear.
Within a period of fewer than 2 days, he could complete all Dimensional Layers and achieve something that would have otherwise been impossible!
As he grasped the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea, this was his only present thought.
But this didn't stay for too long as his consciousness was pulled and tugged upon by something else from the golden Lemniscate in the halcyon skies.
<Providence has shone upon you!>
<100x Aeonic Soul Pills have been generated.>
<The Generation of Loot has ended for the previous 24 Hour Cycle.>
Pure transparent circular crystals that looked like stellar transparent cosmos rained down as they reflected the image of the surrounding skies.
Pure. Transparent.
These were the words one would feel when gazing at these fantastical treasures as they were means to strengthen one's soul!
A type of rate Treasure that would be much sought after even outside the Barren Lands.
And yet Noah was getting his hands on it as when his piercing eyes tried to gain some clarity on these new items...

<Aeonic Soul Pill>:: The Soul is the crux of power. It can dictate how strong the Origin and Body of an existence are as it is the Soul that can comprehend the limitation and understanding of Boundaries, which in turn affect the extent of power one can display. Raising the strength of one's Aeonic Soul is extremely arduous, and Loot that can directly refine one's soul for an elevation in power is even rarer. The Aeonic Soul Pill is capable of elevating the Aeonic Soul Value by .25, making it one of the rare treasures that even beings outside the Barren Lands cannot look down on. A Preliminary understanding shows that this loot can only be affected by an EPOCH IV Relic, so the means of quantity alterations of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor are bound to be meaningless at his current stage...

An addition that caused Noah's eyes to squint as he came to grasp the pill that looked like a transparent Cosmos, its grandeur fantastical as it was akin to looking at an object that released waves of Haki constantly.
An object that increased one's Aeonic Soul Value by .25!
To understand just what this would signify, one had to know their own Aeonic Soul Value.

And in Noah's case, his own Soul had tabulated what he believed to be his comprehensive Quantification of this Value as when he stared at his expanded Status Panel that could spread for a few pages, a multicolored number showed itself that when one focused on it...a small description bloomed!

<Aeonic Soul Value>:: A Quantification of the dynamic relationship of one's soul and the extent it can affect their own Reality and the surrounding Reality. The greater the Soul Value, the greater the control and capability of altering one's own Reality and their surroundings. A high Aeonic Soul Value can dictate the rate that one comprehends abstruse Concepts, the expansion of the boundary of Concepts, the extent of Reality Alteration, and the usage of the Soul to directly alter Reality. When one utilizes their Soul in the alteration of Reality, their Value will momentarily reduce and regenerate over time- something that is also affected by how high the Aeonic Soul Value is. An inquisition into the Soul is required to better grasp the full understanding of one's Aeonic Soul Value. Current Aeonic Soul Value: 78/80. 5% of one's Aeonic Soul Value will regenerate every hour, with this rate being affected by external forces...
The relationship of one's soul and the extent it can affect their own Reality and the surrounding Reality!
Its uses were profound and unfathomable as while forming his Eighth Dimensional Layer, Noah's aspect of the soul was quantified to be 80!

This was the number that came up after looking at him comprehensively...and it was somewhat correlated with his own Realm as since he had 7 out of the 9 Dimensional Realities forged and he was beginning on his Eighth, his Value came out to be approximately 80.
When completed all of his Dimensional Layers and continued receiving the profound elevation of his Aspects of Existence, this Value should reach 100!

But when Noah came across the new skills that would display their Reality Altering effects by stating they would utilize a tenth or a Hundredth of his Aeonic Soul Value, this was the number they were drawing from.

And there was still much to learn about it as Noah needed to quantify the rate of Regeneration of this value fully, because the end of the description stated that it could be affected by external factors as this was the case for him- where there were multiple factors around him that were contributing to his Aeonic Soul Value regenerating rapidly!
This was because after he nearly drained himself through the usage of Infinite Dream, he felt that his soul had nearly returned back to full power after the passage of just a few hours.
So this didn't match the 5% Regeneration expressed in the description of the Aeonic Soul Value.

The factors that could have affected this included the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, Dual Cultivation, absorption of Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas and All Source Enhancers while elevating his Realm...and even his connection to the bound Sources of Nature and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!

All of these were things he had to fully quantify and grasp to better understand his power before he faced the unreasonable Ancestral Descendants, so his gaze returned to the Aeonic Soul Pills that increased one's Value by .25.

They couldn't be Decuplicated by RUINATION at her current stage, but these fantastical treasures could directly take Noah's Aeonic Soul Value to exceed what stage he would be after the completion of his Dimensional Layers!
It was a fantastical Reality to come as Noah wondered...how would this affect the Body and Origin?

From the description of the Aeonic Soul Value, it showed that the stronger it was, the greater one could augment the power of their body and Origin as would Noah be capable of forming his Kainos Royal Cosmos even faster? Require even fewer resources while forming his Dimensional Layers?!
When one Aspect of his became overly strong, other aspects would be pulled up even faster!
There were many more possibilities to think about as the only way to find out...was to elevate the power of his Soul and see for himself.
HOONG!
So he beckoned towards the 100 Aeonic Soul Pills while the mountains of Loot within the Infinite Forge all began to disappear and began their transfer into his Expansive Space!

So this didn't match the 5% Regeneration expressed in the description of the Aeonic Soul Value.

The factors that could have affected this included the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, Dual Cultivation, absorption of Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas and All Source Enhancers while elevating his Realm...and even his connection to the bound Sources of Nature and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!

All of these were things he had to fully quantify and grasp to better understand his power before he faced the unreasonable Ancestral Descendants, so his gaze returned to the Aeonic Soul Pills that increased one's Value by .25.

They couldn't be Decuplicated by RUINATION at her current stage, but these fantastical treasures could directly take Noah's Aeonic Soul Value to exceed what stage he would be after the completion of his Dimensional Layers!
It was a fantastical Reality to come as Noah wondered...how would this affect the Body and Origin?

From the description of the Aeonic Soul Value, it showed that the stronger it was, the greater one could augment the power of their body and Origin as would Noah be capable of forming his Kainos Royal Cosmos even faster?
Require even fewer resources while forming his Dimensional Layers?!
When one Aspect of his became overly strong, other aspects would be pulled up even faster!
There were many more possibilities to think about as the only way to find out...was to elevate the power of his Soul and see for himself.
HOONG!
So he beckoned towards the 100 Aeonic Soul Pills while the mountains of Loot within the Infinite Forge all began to disappear and began their transfer into his Expansive Space!

chapters.title: Chapter 2176 Unprecedented! I
paragraphs: Noah beckoned towards the Aeonic Soul Pills so he could begin to utilize them, while all other Loot that was capable of being multiplied in quantity by RUINATION went to the Expansion Space to undergo this process!

Meanwhile, Noah's Soul began to devour the Aeonic Soul Pills as the portion of his soul remaining in the Infinite Forge grasped one of these stellar transparent crystalline masses on each hand, their size beginning to reduce as he devoured them while his manifested soul released multicolored rays of radiance!
When the transparent waves of essence surged into him, utmost euphoria was experienced as Noah felt a profound strengthening that would normally take the stupendous elevation of one's Realm to occur.
A strengthening that would normally take millions of years for others!
HOONG!
Austere waves of power emanated out grandly as the myriad of Aeonic Soul Pills were pulled towards his soul, everything being sucked up cleanly as a major part of him took great strides in power.

At the same time this occurred, the majesty of the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence was blooming in his Expansive Space where mountains of loot were transferred over- with this Blade focused on multiplying the Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas and All Source Enhancers as the moment they were finished, they were funneled towards Noah's Origin as his Eighth Dimensional Layer fully began to be established with speed!
In this manner, Noah could also observe any changes in Realm Progression while his Aeonic Soul Value was also increasing.
The Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas would be devoured first as thereafter, the All Source Enhancers would follow.
It was the devouring of loot from many sources as within his Origin, a Seed had already bloomed as essence gushed down from all around to help its formation.
A gorgeous Blue color could be seen pervading across this Dimensional Layer that stood above the multicolored Quantum Dimensional Reality.
It was Fantasia!
Its floor was a vast and incandescent sea with such a dense blue hue that one would be blinded by it if they stared for too long.
Above this cerulean sea, a brief sky could be seen as even this...held traces of smaller blue seas floating mystically!

They all shone with cerulean color that was so bright and dense as it continued to flash constantly due to the formation of Kainos Royal Fantasia Cosmos that bloomed within the very seas and liquid skies- beautiful stellar blue cosmic light flashing constantly as Billions of Cosmos formed rapidly.

Noah gazed at every minuscule thing happening as with his Aeonic Soul Value also elevating in power, he could distinctly feel the speed that his Eighth Dimensional Layer devoured the Essences of the Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas was becoming ever faster, to the extent that the All Source Enhancers had to be brought forward very quickly to provide as much essence as possible!
And when they came into the picture...
BZZZT!
In the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, Noah's main body had to momentarily stop his Dual Cultivation with the Seeker of Knowledge as his main body released a heavy burst of power and majesty.

He was devouring the Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas and All Source Enhancers directly from his Expansive Space as it seemed like essence was just pouring into him, but due to his Aeonic Soul Value continued to rise due to the Aeonic Soul Pills- a billowing authority covered everything about him and caused his Origin to feel like a dry desert!

Like a sponge that was desperately taking in all Sources of water around it- and so the Essence of all Decuplicated Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas was instantly devoured as the nearby All Source Enhancers were instantly broken down.
50 Trillion Kainos Royal Fantasia Cosmos.
80 Trillion.
120 Trillion!

Noah's 8th Dimensional Layer which should have undoubtedly taken him much longer to form due to its greater resource requirements...it was being formed at an unprecedented rate as in a matter of seconds, it jumped from barely 5% formed to 60%!
And for the seconds that followed, the grandeur of blue dominated as after 5 seconds...
SHIING!
A cerulean ring of light spread with Noah at the center as a completed Dimensional Layer buzzed with grandiosity.
Within seconds, Fantasia was completed!
<You have successfully completed the Eighth Dimensional Reality.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>
<A version of Pure Undefined Authority has been isolated for your future use above the Fantasia Dimensional Reality.>
<Through your reign over the Fantasia Dimensional Reality, a level of influence can be exerted in the Fantasia Dimension.>
Prompts began to cascade down as Noah's Aeonic Soul Value experienced successive jumps, becoming 90 even without accounting for the additions due to the Aeonic Soul Pills!
And this number was exceeded as Noah finished devouring the Aeonic Soul Pills that with their .25 addition each, 25 Aeonic Soul Values were added to his majesty!
It caused profound waves of power and incandescence to bloom out as in this state, Noah did not want to waste this profound feeling of Resonance at all.

So he ignored the rising prompts of completing the Eighth Dimensional Reality, his Will coming to latch onto the vibrant Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas that had already begun to be multiplied next by RUINATION.

A bit over 2 Million All Source Enhancers were utilized on the formation of the Eighth Dimensional Layer after an initial 4.8 Million Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas were devoured, so there were still well around 3 million All Source Enhancers that he saved for the purposes of elevating constructs or concepts like the Infinite Forge as he now turned his attention on the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas!
He did this as before the boons of the recently built layer could even be shown...
"Begin the formation of the Ninth Dimensional Reality."
WAA!
The allure of gold exploded.
The allure of Elysium was called upon to be the base for the final Dimensional Reality.

The Will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor exploded with waves of unbound Tyranny as he wasted no time to see the end of his Foundation, his power scaling upwards steadily in order to stomp the coming enemies!

chapters.title: Chapter 2177 Unprecedented! II
paragraphs: The winds of change.
The coming of something utterly fantastical and inevitable that when it neared...some beings could instinctively feel it!
As a tyrannical existence took great strides forward with unbelievable speed, the ushering of something new could be felt within the minds of all those powerful enough.
Within the vast stretches of the Boundary Between Realities.

A man floated in this void of Reality as he grasped the hilt of a sword in front, the sharp sword point pointing down as it caused a line of a rupture across the fabric of Reality extending downwards for many light-years!
It was the grand visage of Theseus who caused the other Ancestral Descendants to gaze at him with respect and even a hint of veneration!
It was the renowned existence with great accomplishments in the Boundary of the Sword!
Behind him, a small Legion holding swords similar to his floated in a profound formation as they waded across the Desolate Mausoleum.
At this moment, the pupils of Theseus illuminated with a golden sword light that caused his eyes to squint while gazing at the far reaches of space- seeking something he didn't know of!
But the sword light shining gold in his eyes showed him something akin to what Providence or Destiny would show an existence who was extremely proficient in such concepts.
This was because when one reached a sufficient stage in Boundary Expansion, a concept would not be limited to a category of merely offensive or defensive!
Unimaginable things became possible as geniuses like Theseus who could attain such a stage with the few billion years he had lived...was rare.
So this existence felt the winds of change. But he wasn't the only one.

Far from his location in the Desolate Mausoleum, the visage of The Quantum Emperor floated alone as his gaze seemed to contain countless hidden truths, a pondering expression on his face as he continued searching!
Within folds of the Elysium Dimension.

Hideyoshi thought he felt a pulse echo out across the Dimension in addition to the feeling of great change occurring, his True Authority of Fate burning with golden grandeur as he tried to see the innumerable paths that would unfold!
In the Niflheim Dimension, a shocking battle was blooming as its participants also felt a similar sensation.
All of them felt that something significant was occurring as they had to move even faster since they didn't know exactly what!
In the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

This very construct of clusters of Realities and Dimensions was currently pulsing with grandiosity as they resonated with their Master- the Realm he was on the cusp of attaining being something closely linked to it as well!
9 Dimensional Realities within his Origin, and there were 9 Dimensions that the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality sought to devour and layer them on its current fabric of Reality.

The two were not at all separate as even the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality itself expectantly waited to see what authority was in store when the Origin of its Master had all of the Dimensional Realities forged!
Its will focused on the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature where the visage of Noah's body could be seen.

All activity was paused during this juncture as not just Noah's main body, but even his Clones momentarily stopped their activities as Eowyn, Barbatos, the Seeker of Knowledge, Guinevere, and all others in the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature looked towards Noah and the oppressive pressure he released with a hint of awe.
His body glimmered with 9 stellar bands of light, the Eighth cerulean band that was recently finished shining with utmost incandescence as a golden band was currently in the midst of forming!

The 9 Dimensions were in his Origin, but it seemed like his very body had the foundations of 9 stacked Dimensional Layers that had golden pillars of Ascendancy Stanchions and mountains of Reality Passages supporting everything.

It was utterly glorious to observe as from his Expansive Space, Noah absorbed the Decuplicated Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas while still observing the terrifying effect of an overly strong Aeonic Soul!

He affirmed that even though the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas should have been granting the same effect as 100,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas each, this number was being curved upwards as he...may not truly need to wait until the next cycle of the Infinite Forge to achieve completion of this stage of his Realm.
A stage that after he achieved it would come the question of...exactly where he took it from here.

He was walking on a path he forged himself as he could rely on the methodology that others had designed, but his path was a unique one as there were infinite possibilities as to what he could do with it!

These thoughts, possibilities, and more surged within Noah's mind as while the Elysium Dimensional Layer began its formation, he allowed the prompts of the accomplishment of the Eighth Dimensional Layer to descend over his eyes.
<The Undefined Authority under you has quintessentially increased.>
<The concentration of Undefined Authority has reached a critical level as its identity begins to unfold before you.>
<Your Understanding of the Decretum of Fantasia has been forcefully raised to 50%.>
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 64 Billion.>
<Your Maximum True Vitality Values have risen to 128 Trillion.>
<Your rate of Progression in the Decretum of Fantasia has increased by 1,000,000%>

<The saturated Paramount Kainos Fantasia Dimensional Reality grants a base addition of 14,800,000 Dimensional Fantasia Damage and Defense Values, bringing your Overall Origin Base Value to 28,280,000.>
<20x Pure Quintessential Kainos Natural Decretum Seeds has been obtained.>

His might continued to scale upwards as his base stats experienced Quintessential increases, his life force becoming even more abundant as if someone sought to destroy his main body...the forged Dimension themselves would act as an anchor to prevent dreadful results!

One of the more critical things was that the Undefined Authority that Noah was collecting this whole time while he was forging Dimensional Realities...it had begun to be quantified to his eyes as he truly reached a precipice!
This Undefined Authority was one that allowed him to already pull upon the Anchors that chained the Desolate Mausoleum as it was closely interconnected with the workings of the Barren Lands!
Just...what would Noah be able to do with it at the completion of the Dimensional Realities?

chapters.title: Chapter 2178 Unprecedented! III
paragraphs: Undefined Authority!
This essence surged with blinding brilliance and unveiled its pure white grandeur, shining above the Dimensional Realities and being pulled up towards the highest Layer where Elysium was forming.
It was as if a brilliant white star was rising across stellar layers of planes as when it reached the top...
SHIING!
Incandescent white light illuminated Noah's upper body.
He felt an immense weight of this light as information gradually began to flow into his mind- only now realizing just what importance this Undefined Authority held!

But the grandeur of this essence was too robust as quantifying it took its time, with a missing piece being this same essence produced from the Final Dimensional Layer that was still in its beginning stages right now.
As soon as this was in place, Noah would be able to put together all the pieces and be granted the right to use this Undefined Authority!

And since this was the case, he focused on the completion of this final Dimensional Layer as Decuplicated Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas liquefied to grant their essence unto him, the seed of the Elysium Dimensional Reality already bloomed while fantastical halcyon cosmos formed.

This Layer had the same color as the Dream Dimension, and yet its halcyon grandeur didn't have the sandy feel of the Dream Dimension- instead being very free flowing as if the color itself was simply pure light!
A light that would nourish one's aspects of existence and lead them onto the path that best suited them.
An essence that had a unique relationship with Providence as the two resonated greatly with each other!
The planar floor of this Dimensional Layer was a vastly stretching aurora of light, this aurora extending upwards as one couldn't differentiate a sky.
Amidst this surging halcyon aurora, golden Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos formed en masse as their number already exceeded a few Trillion and continued scaling upwards.

While intently watching the formation of this Layer, Noah continued to monitor the changes of the previous Layer and make sure he wasn't missing any steps- his Will urging Ascendancy Stanchions and Dimensional Reality Passages to rise up between the Quantum and Fantasia Dimensional Layers as their upper tier was expanded yet again!
<Your Affinity to the Decreta of all Dimensions has risen greatly!>
<Your Maximum Number of Ascendancy Stanchions is now 3,000.>
<Your Maximum Number of Infinite Reality Passages is now 4,680.>
<The Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique is Devouring the Fantasia Dimensional Essence and Refining its authority.>
<Your Dimensional Body and Soul continue to experience a profound strengthening and elevation.>
<You have arrived at the point of no return with the completion of the Eighth Dimensional Layer.>
<Proceeding forward and completing the Ninth Dimensional Reality is considered a Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Event as even the reversal of time cannot reverse or alter your Realm after this.>

260 Cycles of the Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique were completed as the number of Quintessential Dimensional Infinite Reality Passages reached a ridiculous number of 4,680 due to each cycle increasing the capacity by 18 Passages.
His Ascendancy Stanchions rose from a maximum of 2,000 to become 3,000 as his Value Multiplier increased even more!
But forgetting all of these numerical details and what they signified for now...it was the last two prompts that caused Noah's gaze to become cold.
In Reality, there were Irreversible Nexus Events that occurred and affected the Main Path and even extended to the countless Parallel Paths.

The Ancestors shackling Reality, OPPENHEIMER splitting apart Reality, and Noah removing the Anchors from the Desolate Mausoleum were perfect examples of events that simply could not be reversed after they had occurred!
Now, Noah was crossing the threshold as with the formation of the final Dimensional Layer, it was considered a Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Event for him!
If he took and finished this step, he could not go back.
If this path was grand in the beginning but not viable towards the end, he couldn't just return across the spacetime continuum or do anything that could reverse what he was about to establish.
Irreversible.
Quintessentially Irreversible!

This was a prompt that might have carried a tremendous weight for genius existences that had lived for millions or billions of years, making them take a pause to just fully grasp the brevity of their choices and actions and how they would affect them in the future.
Whether establishing a new path to follow was worth it when there were so many unknowns!
It was a prompt that could have created doubt in others and whether what they were doing was truly the path to follow!
Yet when the Quintessential Kainos Emperor saw it...
"HMPH!"
WAA!
His Will was roused instead.

His Tyranny surged from the depths of his heart as fantastically, his very Soul cried out in grandiosity as the burning torrents of the Essence of thousands of Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas that were already multiplied by 10 through RUINATION...all of this essence was tyrannically and unbelievably devoured into his Ninth Dimensional Reality instantly.
Every single Decuplicated Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea disappeared!

After the consumption of the Aeonic Soul Pills, Noah saw that the effect of these Panaceas were greatly expanded from the initial equivalency of being worth 100,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas- Noah being able to establish his Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos with a reduced requirement as if he could approximate and quantify it, a single Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea was granting him the equivalency of a range of 150,000-160,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas.
It was a massive and ridiculous increase in efficiency.
It was a change that would be enough to not make him wait a whole day until another cycle of the Infinite Forge came!
But due to the range of equivalency ranging, all of the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas would get Noah close to completing everything...but not all the way there!

So from his remaining few millions of All Source Enhancers...a vast majority also disappeared instantly from the command of a budding will of Tyranny reacting to the prompt of Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Events.
Until...
Everything stopped.
No more essence was taken into Noah's Origin.
There was nowhere for it to go before everything underwent reconstruction and rebirth!

This was because in a span of not microseconds or nanoseconds, but an instant- Noah had reacted tyrannically toward a prompt that questioned his resolve to continue on this path as he absorbed everything needed for the Ninth Dimensional Reality right then and there.
And in that instant...all 200 Trillion Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos flourished.

The hardest, most resource-requiring, most arduous layer to form, the last and final Dimensional Layer....it was formed and finished at an even shorter time than the Layer that came before it as it took but an instant!

But the grandeur of this essence was too robust as quantifying it took its time, with a missing piece being this same essence produced from the Final Dimensional Layer that was still in its beginning stages right now.
As soon as this was in place, Noah would be able to put together all the pieces and be granted the right to use this Undefined Authority!

And since this was the case, he focused on the completion of this final Dimensional Layer as Decuplicated Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas liquefied to grant their essence unto him, the seed of the Elysium Dimensional Reality already bloomed while fantastical halcyon cosmos formed.

This Layer had the same color as the Dream Dimension, and yet its halcyon grandeur didn't have the sandy feel of the Dream Dimension- instead being very free flowing as if the color itself was simply pure light!
A light that would nourish one's aspects of existence and lead them onto the path that best suited them.
An essence that had a unique relationship with Providence as the two resonated greatly with each other!
The planar floor of this Dimensional Layer was a vastly stretching aurora of light, this aurora extending upwards as one couldn't differentiate a sky.
Amidst this surging halcyon aurora, golden Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos formed en masse as their number already exceeded a few Trillion and continued scaling upwards.

While intently watching the formation of this Layer, Noah continued to monitor the changes of the previous Layer and make sure he wasn't missing any steps- his Will urging Ascendancy Stanchions and Dimensional Reality Passages to rise up between the Quantum and Fantasia Dimensional Layers as their upper tier was expanded yet again!
<Your Affinity to the Decreta of all Dimensions has risen greatly!>
<Your Maximum Number of Ascendancy Stanchions is now 3,000.>
<Your Maximum Number of Infinite Reality Passages is now 4,680.>
<The Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique is Devouring the Fantasia Dimensional Essence and Refining its authority.>
<Your Dimensional Body and Soul continue to experience a profound strengthening and elevation.>
<You have arrived at the point of no return with the completion of the Eighth Dimensional Layer.>
<Proceeding forward and completing the Ninth Dimensional Reality is considered a Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Event as even the reversal of time cannot reverse or alter your Realm after this.>

260 Cycles of the Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique were completed as the number of Quintessential Dimensional Infinite Reality Passages reached a ridiculous number of 4,680 due to each cycle increasing the capacity by 18 Passages.
His Ascendancy Stanchions rose from a maximum of 2,000 to become 3,000 as his Value Multiplier increased even more!
But forgetting all of these numerical details and what they signified for now...it was the last two prompts that caused Noah's gaze to become cold.
In Reality, there were Irreversible Nexus Events that occurred and affected the Main Path and even extended to the countless Parallel Paths.

The Ancestors shackling Reality, OPPENHEIMER splitting apart Reality, and Noah removing the Anchors from the Desolate Mausoleum were perfect examples of events that simply could not be reversed after they had occurred!
Now, Noah was crossing the threshold as with the formation of the final Dimensional Layer, it was considered a Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Event for him!
If he took and finished this step, he could not go back.
If this path was grand in the beginning but not viable towards the end, he couldn't just return across the spacetime continuum or do anything that could reverse what he was about to establish.
Irreversible.
Quintessentially Irreversible!

This was a prompt that might have carried a tremendous weight for genius existences that had lived for millions or billions of years, making them take a pause to just fully grasp the brevity of their choices and actions and how they would affect them in the future.
Whether establishing a new path to follow was worth it when there were so many unknowns!
It was a prompt that could have created doubt in others and whether what they were doing was truly the path to follow!
Yet when the Quintessential Kainos Emperor saw it...
"HMPH!"
WAA!
His Will was roused instead.

His Tyranny surged from the depths of his heart as fantastically, his very Soul cried out in grandiosity as the burning torrents of the Essence of thousands of Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas that were already multiplied by 10 through RUINATION...all of this essence was tyrannically and unbelievably devoured into his Ninth Dimensional Reality instantly.
Every single Decuplicated Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea disappeared!

After the consumption of the Aeonic Soul Pills, Noah saw that the effect of these Panaceas were greatly expanded from the initial equivalency of being worth 100,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas- Noah being able to establish his Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos with a reduced requirement as if he could approximate and quantify it, a single Crimson Dimensional Reality Panacea was granting him the equivalency of a range of 150,000-160,000 Obsidian Dimensional Reality Panaceas.
It was a massive and ridiculous increase in efficiency.
It was a change that would be enough to not make him wait a whole day until another cycle of the Infinite Forge came!
But due to the range of equivalency ranging, all of the Crimson Dimensional Reality Panaceas would get Noah close to completing everything...but not all the way there!

So from his remaining few millions of All Source Enhancers...a vast majority also disappeared instantly from the command of a budding will of Tyranny reacting to the prompt of Quintessential Irreversible Nexus Events.
Until...
Everything stopped.
No more essence was taken into Noah's Origin.
There was nowhere for it to go before everything underwent reconstruction and rebirth!

This was because in a span of not microseconds or nanoseconds, but an instant- Noah had reacted tyrannically toward a prompt that questioned his resolve to continue on this path as he absorbed everything needed for the Ninth Dimensional Reality right then and there.
And in that instant...all 200 Trillion Kainos Royal Elysium Cosmos flourished.

The hardest, most resource-requiring, most arduous layer to form, the last and final Dimensional Layer....it was formed and finished at an even shorter time than the Layer that came before it as it took but an instant!

chapters.title: Chapter 2179 My Path! I
paragraphs: The tyrannical will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor felt like it was besmirched!
Like the prompt that had risen before it had intended to make him pause just for a second to think about his completion of the 9 Dimensional Realities!
So his soul roared out with dominance and grandiosity as he let it be known that he fully trusted himself in the path he followed- and he would never regret it.
To him, there was no worry of the future and whether this path he followed would make way for grander pastures or possibly fail.
He simply...held such immense levels of confidence in himself that he knew no matter the outcome, he would overcome it and come out on the other side with even more majesty.
It did not matter that he could not reverse it once he proceeded forward!

And to show this conviction, he completed one of the more profoundly Quintessential acts in his life by completing the hardest Dimensional Layer to forge...faster than even the easiest and First Dimensional Reality that he forged.
An instant.
This was his answer.
And it was a mighty response!
HOOONG!
A blaring sound akin to a horn blowing away the farthest ends of Reality bellowed out as it stretched out across the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
It then extended much further outwards as without revealing its Source, this bellowing horn responded out across the far reaches of the Boundary Between Realities!
It cascaded into the folds of space to even echo out across the remaining Anchors, this bellowing horn causing many heads to turn!
It was the coming of something utterly glorious that let itself be known.
At the very source of this booming bellow, Noah's visage could be seen.
It was spotlessly pure at this juncture as his whole body had seemingly turned transparent.
His stellar vessels, bones, organs, and musculature could be seen as overlapping all of these were 9 layers of pure incandescent light.
They began with gold at the very bottom and finished with gold at the very top.
Dream, Avalon, Prana, Apollyon, Mirror, Niflheim, Quantum, Fantasia, and Elysium.

9 Layers of Dimensions overlapped on his body as at this moment, they pulsed with magisterial Resonance to release a pillar of pure white light- light that coveted Noah entirely as it exploded into tendrils that began to spin around him like a web!
Like a cocoon!

And it had to be so as his body and Origin were undergoing a profound transformation, his soul also following as before he became fully wrapped in the white cocoon, those near this region of the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature could already see his stellar skin beginning to peel off of his body as if he were a canvas.
This was what they saw.
But for Noah...it was very, very different!
For him, many things happened in the span of an instant as it seemed like countless Prompts rained down, but he could only focus on a single one that pervaded into his mind.
<The Undefined Authority has been quantified as the Authority of this Era.>
The Authority of an Era!
An Era!
It was something that constituted of an unknown number of Ages as after the Olden Era, there came the Kainos Era!

This Era had only just begun with the Age of Quintessence, and at this juncture, it was shown that Noah had been collecting the authority of this entire Era through his actions when he began to build Dimensional Realities that correlated to the actual 9 Dimensions.
It was Kainos Authority!

<Attaining the Authority of an entire Era is an impossibility that only became a possibility after the actions of the Ancestors that enacted cycles of Ages. Your path and actions have made it possible for you to accumulate this profound Authority due to their direct effects on the fabric of Reality.>
WAA!
Even more information surged into Noah's mind, but it wasn't just this as this terrifying torrent of Kainos Authority was currently pushing inside his body as if it could explode out at any second!
<Your Aspects of Existence are currently undergoing a Quintessential Transformation.>
<The forged 9 Dimensional Realities are resonating with the 9 Dimensions of the Barren Lands and portions of its fabric of Reality.>
At this juncture, the Dream, Avalon, and Apollyon Dimensions in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality began to pulse with Resonance.
A low thrumming pulse as waves of transparent light echoed out towards Noah's figure and bounced off of him joyfully!

A unique phenomenon bloomed as it didn't just affect the 3 Dimensions Noah had bound to his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, but the remaining 6 Dimensional Planes stretched out across the folds of the Barren Lands.
The very Sources of these Dimensions began to resonate.
It was the build-up of something unprecedented and incalculable for others as Quintessential changes took place!
And while this effect occurred outside Noah's body...
<The Authority of the Age of Quintessence is being mobilized to reforge your Aspects of Existence.>
RUMBLE!

Utmost glory and brilliance emanated from him as the backbone of a throne above and behind Noah released blinding light, a surge of multicolored stellar essence gushing from it and sinking into the white cocoon in a show of grandiosity!
But this wasn't all!
<The Authority of the Era of Kainos is being mobilized to reforge your Aspects of Existence.>
<Your current Tier of Existence cannot withstand too much Kainos Authority.>
<You have gained the unique privilege to direct and focus the usage of the Authority of this Era towards a specific area of yourself.>
The Authority of an Era that could not be freely controlled!
It was a culmination of a prize for a lot of hard work, and it granted Noah the right to focus a portion of it on a specific area that he wanted.
His choice would be crucial as this was one of the critical boons for completing all 9 Dimensional Realities!
Would he focus it further on his Aspects of Existence that were already being reforged with this Authority? Would he focus it on his Systems? RUINATION? The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality?
No.
His Will was luminous and unfathomable as it gazed at an extremely far away place.
And then...he spoke with surety!
